    16→// TestShadowStrategy_MidSessionCommit_FromTranscript tests that when Claude commits
    17→// mid-session (before Stop has been called), the prepare-commit-msg hook detects
    18→// the new work by checking the live transcript and adds a checkpoint trailer.
    19→//
    20→// This is scenario 2 from ENT-112:
    21→// - User prompts Claude
    22→// - Claude creates files and commits them
    23→// - No Stop has happened yet (no shadow branch)
    24→// - The commit should still get a checkpoint trailer because the transcript shows file modifications
    25→func TestShadowStrategy_MidSessionCommit_FromTranscript(t *testing.T) {
    26→	t.Parallel()
    27→
    28→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
    29→
    30→	session := env.NewSession()
    31→
    32→	// Simulate user prompt (initializes session with BaseCommit and TranscriptPath)
    33→	// We need to pass the transcript path so it gets stored in session state
    34→	input := map[string]string{
    35→		"session_id":      session.ID,
    36→		"transcript_path": session.TranscriptPath,
    37→	}
    38→	inputJSON, _ := json.Marshal(input)
    39→	cmd := exec.Command(getTestBinary(), "hooks", "claude-code", "user-prompt-submit")
    40→	cmd.Dir = env.RepoDir
    41→	cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(inputJSON)
    42→	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
    43→		"ENTIRE_TEST_CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="+env.ClaudeProjectDir,
    44→	)
    45→	if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
    46→		t.Fatalf("user-prompt-submit failed: %v\nOutput: %s", err, output)
    47→	}
    48→
    49→	// Verify session state has transcript path
    50→	state, err := env.GetSessionState(session.ID)
    51→	if err != nil {
    52→		t.Fatalf("Failed to get session state: %v", err)
    53→	}
    54→	if state == nil {
    55→		t.Fatal("Session state is nil")
    56→	}
    57→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
    58→		t.Error("Session state should have TranscriptPath after user-prompt-submit")
    59→	}
    60→	t.Logf("Session state TranscriptPath: %s", state.TranscriptPath)
    61→
    62→	// Create a file as if Claude wrote it
    63→	env.WriteFile("claude_file.txt", "content from Claude")
    64→
    65→	// Create transcript showing Claude created the file (NO Stop called)
    66→	session.CreateTranscript("Create a file for me", []FileChange{
    67→		{Path: "claude_file.txt", Content: "content from Claude"},
    68→	})
    69→
    70→	// Verify NO shadow branch exists (Stop hasn't been called)
    71→	shadowBranches := env.ListBranchesWithPrefix("entire/")
    72→	hasShadowBranch := false
    73→	for _, b := range shadowBranches {
    74→		if b != paths.MetadataBranchName {
    75→			hasShadowBranch = true
    76→			break
    77→		}
    78→	}
    79→	if hasShadowBranch {
    80→		t.Error("Shadow branch should not exist before Stop is called")
    81→	}
    82→
    83→	// Get HEAD before commit
    84→	headBefore := env.GetHeadHash()
    85→
    86→	// Commit with shadow hooks - should add trailer because transcript shows file modifications
    87→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add file from Claude (mid-session)", "claude_file.txt")
    88→
    89→	// Get the commit
    90→	commitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
    91→	if commitHash == headBefore {
    92→		t.Fatal("Commit was not created")
    93→	}
    94→
    95→	// CRITICAL: Verify commit has a checkpoint trailer
    96→	// This is the fix for ENT-112 scenario 2: detect work from live transcript
    97→	checkpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commitHash)
    98→	if checkpointID == "" {
    99→		t.Error("Mid-session commit should have Entire-Checkpoint trailer when transcript shows file modifications")
   100→	} else {
   101→		t.Logf("Mid-session commit has checkpoint ID: %s", checkpointID)
   102→	}
   103→}

    19→// TestShadow_FullWorkflow tests the complete shadow workflow as described in
    20→// docs/requirements/shadow-strategy/example.md
    21→//
    22→// This test simulates Alice's workflow:
    23→// 1. Start session, create checkpoints
    24→// 2. Rewind to earlier checkpoint
    25→// 3. Create new checkpoint after rewind
    26→// 4. User commits (triggers condensation)
    27→// 5. Continue working after commit (new shadow branch)
    28→// 6. User commits again (second condensation)
    29→// 7. Verify final state
    30→func TestShadow_FullWorkflow(t *testing.T) {
    31→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
    32→	defer env.Cleanup()
    33→
    34→	// ========================================
    35→	// Phase 1: Setup
    36→	// ========================================
    37→	env.InitRepo()
    38→
    39→	// Create initial commit on main
    40→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test Repository")
    41→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
    42→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
    43→
    44→	// Switch to feature branch (shadow skips main/master)
    45→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/auth")
    46→
    47→	// Initialize Entire AFTER branch switch to avoid go-git cleaning untracked files
    48→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
    49→
    50→	initialHead := env.GetHeadHash()
    51→	t.Logf("Initial HEAD on feature/auth: %s", initialHead[:7])
    52→
    53→	// ========================================
    54→	// Phase 2: Session Start & First Checkpoint
    55→	// ========================================
    56→	t.Log("Phase 2: Starting session and creating first checkpoint")
    57→
    58→	session := env.NewSession()
    59→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
    60→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
    61→	}
    62→
    63→	// Verify session state file exists in .git/entire-sessions/
    64→	sessionStateDir := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, ".git", "entire-sessions")
    65→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(sessionStateDir)
    66→	if err != nil {
    67→		t.Fatalf("Failed to read session state dir: %v", err)
    68→	}
    69→	if len(entries) == 0 {
    70→		t.Error("Expected session state file in .git/entire-sessions/")
    71→	}
    72→
    73→	// Create first file (src/auth.go)
    74→	authV1 := "package auth\n\nfunc Authenticate(user, pass string) bool {\n\treturn false\n}"
    75→	env.WriteFile("src/auth.go", authV1)
    76→
    77→	session.CreateTranscript(
    78→		"Create authentication module",
    79→		[]FileChange{{Path: "src/auth.go", Content: authV1}},
    80→	)
    81→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
    82→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 1) failed: %v", err)
    83→	}
    84→
    85→	// Verify shadow branch created with correct worktree-specific naming
    86→	expectedShadowBranch := env.GetShadowBranchNameForCommit(initialHead)
    87→	if !env.BranchExists(expectedShadowBranch) {
    88→		t.Errorf("Expected shadow branch %s to exist", expectedShadowBranch)
    89→	}
    90→
    91→	// Verify 1 rewind point
    92→	points := env.GetRewindPoints()
    93→	if len(points) != 1 {
    94→		t.Fatalf("Expected 1 rewind point after first checkpoint, got %d", len(points))
    95→	}
    96→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 1 created: %s", points[0].Message)
    97→
    98→	// ========================================
    99→	// Phase 3: Second Checkpoint (continuing same session)
   100→	// ========================================
   101→	t.Log("Phase 3: Creating second checkpoint (continuing same session)")
   102→
   103→	// Continue the same session (not a new session) - this is the expected Claude behavior
   104→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   105→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (checkpoint 2) failed: %v", err)
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	// Create hash.go and modify auth.go
   109→	hashV1 := "package auth\n\nimport \"crypto/sha256\"\n\nfunc HashPassword(pass string) []byte {\n\th := sha256.Sum256([]byte(pass))\n\treturn h[:]\n}"
   110→	authV2 := "package auth\n\nfunc Authenticate(user, pass string) bool {\n\t// TODO: use hashed passwords\n\treturn false\n}"
   111→	env.WriteFile("src/hash.go", hashV1)
   112→	env.WriteFile("src/auth.go", authV2)
   113→
   114→	// Reset transcript builder for the new checkpoint
   115→	session.TranscriptBuilder = NewTranscriptBuilder()
   116→	session.CreateTranscript(
   117→		"Add password hashing",
   118→		[]FileChange{
   119→			{Path: "src/hash.go", Content: hashV1},
   120→			{Path: "src/auth.go", Content: authV2},
   121→		},
   122→	)
   123→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   124→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 2) failed: %v", err)
   125→	}
   126→
   127→	// Verify 2 rewind points on same shadow branch
   128→	points = env.GetRewindPoints()
   129→	if len(points) != 2 {
   130→		t.Fatalf("Expected 2 rewind points after second checkpoint, got %d", len(points))
   131→	}
   132→	t.Logf("Checkpoint 2 created: %s", points[0].Message)
   133→
   134→	// Verify both files exist
   135→	if !env.FileExists("src/hash.go") {
   136→		t.Error("src/hash.go should exist after checkpoint 2")
   137→	}
   138→	if content := env.ReadFile("src/auth.go"); content != authV2 {

   140→	}

   144→	// ========================================

   148→	var checkpoint1ID string

   161→	}

   165→		t.Error("src/hash.go should NOT exist after rewind to checkpoint 1")

   199→	authV3 := "package auth\n\nfunc Authenticate(user, pass string) bool {\n\t// Use bcrypt for password hashing\n\treturn false\n}"
   200→	env.WriteFile("src/bcrypt.go", bcryptV1)

   402→// TestShadow_MultipleConcurrentSessions tests that starting a second Claude session
   403→// while another session has uncommitted checkpoints triggers a warning.
   404→// The first prompt is blocked with continue:false, subsequent prompts proceed.
   405→func TestShadow_MultipleConcurrentSessions(t *testing.T) {
   406→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
   407→	defer env.Cleanup()
   408→
   409→	env.InitRepo()
   410→
   411→	env.WriteFile("README.md", "# Test")
   412→	env.GitAdd("README.md")
   413→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
   414→
   415→	env.GitCheckoutNewBranch("feature/test")
   416→
   417→	// Initialize AFTER branch switch
   418→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   419→
   420→	// Start first session
   421→	session1 := env.NewSession()
   422→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session1.ID); err != nil {
   423→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (session1) failed: %v", err)
   424→	}
   425→
   426→	// Create a checkpoint for session1 (this creates the shadow branch)
   427→	env.WriteFile("file.txt", "content")
   428→	session1.CreateTranscript("Add file", []FileChange{{Path: "file.txt", Content: "content"}})
   429→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   430→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (session1) failed: %v", err)
   431→	}
   432→
   433→	// Verify session state file exists
   434→	sessionStateDir := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, ".git", "entire-sessions")
   435→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(sessionStateDir)
   436→	if err != nil {
   437→		t.Fatalf("Failed to read session state dir: %v", err)
   438→	}
   439→	if len(entries) != 1 {
   440→		t.Errorf("Expected 1 session state file, got %d", len(entries))
   441→	}
   442→
   443→	// Starting a second session while session1 has uncommitted checkpoints triggers warning
   444→	// The hook outputs JSON {"continue":false,...} but returns nil (success)
   445→	session2 := env.NewSession()
   446→	err = env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session2.ID)
   447→	// The hook succeeds (returns nil) but outputs JSON with continue:false
   448→	// The test infrastructure treats this as success since the hook didn't return an error
   449→	if err != nil {
   450→		t.Logf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit returned error (expected in some cases): %v", err)
   451→	}
   452→
   453→	// Verify session2 state file was created with ConcurrentWarningShown flag
   454→	// This is set by the hook when it outputs continue:false
   455→	entries, err = os.ReadDir(sessionStateDir)
   456→	if err != nil {
   457→		t.Fatalf("Failed to read session state dir: %v", err)
   458→	}
   459→	if len(entries) != 2 {
   460→		t.Errorf("Expected 2 session state files after second session attempt, got %d", len(entries))
   461→	}
   462→
   463→	// Clear session1 state file - this makes the shadow branch "orphaned"
   464→	if err := env.ClearSessionState(session1.ID); err != nil {
   465→		t.Fatalf("ClearSessionState failed: %v", err)
   466→	}
   467→
   468→	// Session2 had ConcurrentWarningShown=true, but now the conflict is resolved
   469→	// (session1 state cleared), so the warning flag is cleared and hooks proceed normally.
   470→	// The orphaned shadow branch (from session1) is reset, allowing session2 to proceed.
   471→	err = env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session2.ID)
   472→	if err != nil {
   473→		t.Errorf("Expected success after orphaned shadow branch is reset, got: %v", err)
   474→	} else {
   475→		t.Log("Session2 proceeded after orphaned shadow branch was reset")
   476→	}
   477→}

   528→
   529→	// Next prompt should migrate the shadow branch

   540→	}
   541→
   542→	// Verify we can still create checkpoints on the new shadow branch

   548→	}
   549→
   550→	// Verify session state has updated base commit and preserves agent type
   551→	state, err := env.GetSessionState(session.ID)
   552→	if err != nil {

   557→	}
   558→	if state.StepCount != 2 {

  1424→// TestShadow_RewindPreservesUntrackedFilesWithExistingShadowBranch tests that untracked files

  1446→	t.Log("Phase 1: Create a previous session to establish shadow branch")

  1474→

  1484→	session1.TranscriptBuilder = NewTranscriptBuilder()
  1485→
  1486→	// Second checkpoint of session - should capture .claude/settings.json
  1487→	env.WriteFile("a.go", "package main\n\nfunc A() {}\n")

  1489→	session1.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")

  1493→	if err := session1.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {

  1496→
  1497→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session1.ID, session1.TranscriptPath); err != nil {

  1500→
  1501→	rewindPoints := env.GetRewindPoints()
  1502→	if len(rewindPoints) < 2 {

  1506→	checkpoint1 := &rewindPoints[0] // Most recent first

  1539→	// Verify that the untracked file that existed at session start is PRESERVED

  1542→	if !env.FileExists(".claude/settings.json") {
  1543→		t.Error(".claude/settings.json should have been preserved during rewind")
  1544→	} else {
  1545→		restoredContent := env.ReadFile(".claude/settings.json")
  1546→		if restoredContent != untrackedContent {
  1547→			t.Errorf("Untracked file content changed.\nExpected:\n%s\nGot:\n%s", untrackedContent, restoredContent)
  1548→		} else {
  1549→			t.Log("✓ .claude/settings.json was preserved correctly")
  1550→		}
  1551→	}
  1552→
  1553→	// Verify b.go was deleted
  1554→	if env.FileExists("b.go") {
  1555→		t.Error("b.go should have been deleted during rewind")
  1556→	} else {
  1557→		t.Log("✓ b.go was correctly deleted during rewind")
  1558→	}
  1559→
  1560→	t.Log("Test completed successfully!")
  1561→}

  1652→	// This time, keep the trailer (normal commit with hooks)

  1654→
  1655→	commit2Hash := env.GetHeadHash()

    17→// TestShadow_CommitBeforeStop tests the "commit while agent is still working" flow.
    18→//
    19→// When the user commits while the agent is in the ACTIVE phase (between
    20→// SimulateUserPromptSubmit and SimulateStop), the session should transition to
    21→// ACTIVE_COMMITTED. This defers condensation because the agent is still working.
    22→// When the agent finishes its turn (SimulateStop), the deferred condensation fires
    23→// and the session transitions to IDLE with metadata persisted to entire/sessions.
    24→//
    25→// State machine transitions tested:
    26→//   - ACTIVE + GitCommit -> ACTIVE_COMMITTED (defer condensation, migrate shadow branch)
    27→//   - ACTIVE_COMMITTED + TurnEnd -> IDLE + ActionCondense (deferred condensation fires)
    28→func TestShadow_CommitBeforeStop(t *testing.T) {
    29→	t.Parallel()
    30→
    31→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
    32→
    33→	// ========================================
    34→	// Phase 1: Start session and create initial checkpoint
    35→	// ========================================
    36→	t.Log("Phase 1: Start session and create initial work")
    37→
    38→	sess := env.NewSession()
    39→
    40→	// Pass transcript path in the hook input so it's stored in session state
    41→	// (needed for mid-session commit detection via live transcript)
    42→	submitWithTranscriptPath := func(sessionID, transcriptPath string) {
    43→		t.Helper()
    44→		input := map[string]string{
    45→			"session_id":      sessionID,
    46→			"transcript_path": transcriptPath,
    47→		}
    48→		inputJSON, _ := json.Marshal(input)
    49→		cmd := exec.Command(getTestBinary(), "hooks", "claude-code", "user-prompt-submit")
    50→		cmd.Dir = env.RepoDir
    51→		cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(inputJSON)
    52→		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
    53→			"ENTIRE_TEST_CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="+env.ClaudeProjectDir,
    54→		)
    55→		if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
    56→			t.Fatalf("user-prompt-submit failed: %v\nOutput: %s", err, output)
    57→		}
    58→	}
    59→
    60→	submitWithTranscriptPath(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath)
    61→
    62→	// Verify session is ACTIVE
    63→	state, err := env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
    64→	if err != nil {
    65→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
    66→	}
    67→	if state == nil {
    68→		t.Fatal("Session state should exist")
    69→	}
    70→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseActive {
    71→		t.Errorf("Phase after first prompt should be %q, got %q", session.PhaseActive, state.Phase)
    72→	}
    73→
    74→	// Create a file and transcript, then stop (first checkpoint)
    75→	env.WriteFile("feature.go", "package main\n\nfunc Feature() {}\n")
    76→	sess.CreateTranscript("Create feature function", []FileChange{
    77→		{Path: "feature.go", Content: "package main\n\nfunc Feature() {}\n"},
    78→	})
    79→	if err := env.SimulateStop(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
    80→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 1) failed: %v", err)
    81→	}
    82→
    83→	// Verify session is IDLE after stop
    84→	state, err = env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
    85→	if err != nil {
    86→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
    87→	}
    88→	if state == nil {
    89→		t.Fatal("Session state should exist")
    90→	}
    91→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseIdle {
    92→		t.Errorf("Phase after first stop should be %q, got %q", session.PhaseIdle, state.Phase)
    93→	}
    94→	if state.StepCount != 1 {
    95→		t.Errorf("StepCount after first checkpoint should be 1, got %d", state.StepCount)
    96→	}
    97→
    98→	// Verify shadow branch was created
    99→	initialHead := state.BaseCommit
   100→	shadowBranch := env.GetShadowBranchNameForCommit(initialHead)
   101→	if !env.BranchExists(shadowBranch) {
   102→		t.Fatalf("Shadow branch %s should exist after first checkpoint", shadowBranch)
   103→	}
   104→
   105→	// ========================================
   106→	// Phase 2: Start new turn and create more work
   107→	// ========================================
   108→	t.Log("Phase 2: Start new turn, create more work")
   109→
   110→	submitWithTranscriptPath(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath)
   111→
   112→	state, err = env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
   113→	if err != nil {
   114→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
   115→	}
   116→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseActive {
   117→		t.Errorf("Phase after second prompt should be %q, got %q", session.PhaseActive, state.Phase)
   118→	}
   119→
   120→	// Create another file and write updated transcript
   121→	env.WriteFile("utils.go", "package main\n\nfunc Util() {}\n")
   122→	sess.TranscriptBuilder = NewTranscriptBuilder()
   123→	sess.CreateTranscript("Create utils", []FileChange{
   124→		{Path: "utils.go", Content: "package main\n\nfunc Util() {}\n"},
   125→	})
   126→
   127→	// Do NOT stop yet -- the agent is still ACTIVE
   128→
   129→	// ========================================
   130→	// Phase 3: User commits while agent is ACTIVE
   131→	// ========================================
   132→	t.Log("Phase 3: User commits while agent is ACTIVE")
   133→
   134→	headBefore := env.GetHeadHash()
   135→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add feature and utils", "feature.go", "utils.go")
   136→	commitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
   137→
   138→	if commitHash == headBefore {
   139→		t.Fatal("Commit was not created")
   140→	}
   141→
   142→	// Verify checkpoint trailer was added
   143→	checkpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commitHash)
   144→	if checkpointID == "" {
   145→		t.Log("Note: checkpoint trailer may not be present if no shadow branch content was detected (mid-session commit scenario)")
   146→	} else {
   147→		t.Logf("Commit has checkpoint trailer: %s", checkpointID)
   148→	}
   149→
   150→	// CRITICAL: Verify session phase is ACTIVE_COMMITTED
   151→	state, err = env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
   152→	if err != nil {
   153→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
   154→	}
   155→	if state == nil {
   156→		t.Fatal("Session state should exist after commit")
   157→	}
   158→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseActiveCommitted {
   159→		t.Errorf("Phase after commit-while-active should be %q, got %q",
   160→			session.PhaseActiveCommitted, state.Phase)
   161→	}
   162→	t.Logf("Session phase after mid-turn commit: %s", state.Phase)
   163→
   164→	// Verify shadow branch was migrated to the new HEAD
   165→	// The old shadow branch (based on initialHead) may still exist or be cleaned up.
   166→	// The important thing is that the session's BaseCommit was updated.
   167→	if state.BaseCommit == initialHead {
   168→		t.Logf("Note: BaseCommit not yet updated (may happen during migration)")
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	// ========================================
   172→	// Phase 4: Agent finishes turn (SimulateStop)
   173→	// ========================================
   174→	t.Log("Phase 4: Agent finishes turn (SimulateStop)")
   175→
   176→	if err := env.SimulateStop(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   177→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (after commit) failed: %v", err)
   178→	}
   179→
   180→	// Verify session transitions to IDLE
   181→	state, err = env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
   182→	if err != nil {
   183→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
   184→	}
   185→	if state == nil {
   186→		t.Fatal("Session state should exist after stop")
   187→	}
   188→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseIdle {
   189→		t.Errorf("Phase after stop from ACTIVE_COMMITTED should be %q, got %q",
   190→			session.PhaseIdle, state.Phase)
   191→	}
   192→	t.Logf("Session phase after stop: %s (StepCount: %d)", state.Phase, state.StepCount)
   193→
   194→	// Deferred condensation should have fired during TurnEnd (ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE).
   195→	// Verify StepCount was reset and metadata was persisted to entire/sessions.
   196→	if state.StepCount != 0 {
   197→		t.Errorf("StepCount should be 0 after TurnEnd condensation, got %d", state.StepCount)
   198→	}
   199→
   200→	if !env.BranchExists(paths.MetadataBranchName) {
   201→		t.Fatal("entire/sessions branch should exist after TurnEnd condensation")
   202→	}
   203→	latestCheckpointID := env.TryGetLatestCheckpointID()
   204→	if latestCheckpointID != "" {
   205→		summaryPath := CheckpointSummaryPath(latestCheckpointID)
   206→		if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, summaryPath) {
   207→			t.Errorf("Checkpoint metadata should exist at %s", summaryPath)
   208→		} else {
   209→			t.Logf("Condensed data exists at checkpoint %s", latestCheckpointID)
   210→		}
   211→	}
   212→
   213→	t.Log("CommitBeforeStop test completed successfully")
   214→}

   216→// TestShadow_AmendPreservesTrailer tests that `git commit --amend` preserves
   217→// the checkpoint trailer from the original commit.
   218→//
   219→// When a user amends a commit that has an Entire-Checkpoint trailer, the
   220→// prepare-commit-msg hook (called with source="commit") should preserve the
   221→// existing trailer. No duplicate condensation should occur.
   222→//
   223→// Hook behavior tested:
   224→//   - prepare-commit-msg with source="commit": preserves existing trailer
   225→//   - post-commit after amend: no duplicate condensation
   226→func TestShadow_AmendPreservesTrailer(t *testing.T) {
   227→	t.Parallel()
   228→
   229→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   230→
   231→	// ========================================
   232→	// Phase 1: Full workflow - create checkpoint and commit
   233→	// ========================================
   234→	t.Log("Phase 1: Create session, checkpoint, and commit")
   235→
   236→	sess := env.NewSession()
   237→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(sess.ID); err != nil {
   238→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
   239→	}
   240→
   241→	// Create a file and checkpoint
   242→	env.WriteFile("main.go", "package main\n\nfunc main() {}\n")
   243→	sess.CreateTranscript("Create main.go", []FileChange{
   244→		{Path: "main.go", Content: "package main\n\nfunc main() {}\n"},
   245→	})
   246→	if err := env.SimulateStop(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   247→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
   248→	}
   249→
   250→	// Commit with hooks (triggers condensation)
   251→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Initial implementation", "main.go")
   252→
   253→	originalCommitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
   254→	originalCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(originalCommitHash)
   255→	if originalCheckpointID == "" {
   256→		t.Fatal("Original commit should have a checkpoint trailer")
   257→	}
   258→	t.Logf("Original commit %s has checkpoint ID: %s", originalCommitHash[:7], originalCheckpointID)
   259→
   260→	// Verify condensation happened
   261→	if !env.BranchExists(paths.MetadataBranchName) {
   262→		t.Fatal("entire/sessions branch should exist after condensation")
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	// Record the sessions branch state for later comparison
   266→	sessionsCommitBefore := env.GetLatestCommitMessageOnBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName)
   267→	t.Logf("Sessions branch commit before amend:\n%s", sessionsCommitBefore)
   268→
   269→	// ========================================
   270→	// Phase 2: Amend the commit
   271→	// ========================================
   272→	t.Log("Phase 2: Amend the commit")
   273→
   274→	// Amend with the same message (simulating a minor message edit or staging additional files)
   275→	env.GitCommitAmendWithShadowHooks("Initial implementation (amended)")
   276→
   277→	amendedCommitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
   278→	t.Logf("Amended commit: %s", amendedCommitHash[:7])
   279→
   280→	// The amended commit hash should be different from the original
   281→	if amendedCommitHash == originalCommitHash {
   282→		t.Error("Amended commit should have a different hash")
   283→	}
   284→
   285→	// ========================================
   286→	// Phase 3: Verify trailer is preserved
   287→	// ========================================
   288→	t.Log("Phase 3: Verify checkpoint trailer is preserved")
   289→
   290→	amendedCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(amendedCommitHash)
   291→	if amendedCheckpointID == "" {
   292→		t.Fatal("Amended commit should still have a checkpoint trailer")
   293→	}
   294→	t.Logf("Amended commit has checkpoint ID: %s", amendedCheckpointID)
   295→
   296→	// The checkpoint ID should be the SAME as the original
   297→	if amendedCheckpointID != originalCheckpointID {
   298→		t.Errorf("Amended commit should preserve original checkpoint ID.\nOriginal: %s\nAmended:  %s",
   299→			originalCheckpointID, amendedCheckpointID)
   300→	}
   301→
   302→	// ========================================
   303→	// Phase 4: Verify no duplicate condensation
   304→	// ========================================

   306→
   307→	// The sessions branch commit should not have changed (no new condensation)
   308→	sessionsCommitAfter := env.GetLatestCommitMessageOnBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName)

   313→		// if there's new content. But with no new session activity, it should be the same.
   314→		t.Log("Note: sessions branch was updated (may indicate duplicate condensation)")
   315→	} else {
   316→		t.Log("Sessions branch unchanged after amend (no duplicate condensation)")

    18→// TestManualCommit_Attribution tests the full attribution calculation flow:
    19→// 1. Agent creates checkpoint 1
    20→// 2. User makes changes between checkpoints
    21→// 3. User enters new prompt (attribution calculated at prompt start)
    22→// 4. Agent creates checkpoint 2
    23→// 5. User commits (condensation happens with attribution)
    24→// 6. Verify attribution metadata is correct
    25→func TestManualCommit_Attribution(t *testing.T) {
    26→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
    27→	defer env.Cleanup()
    28→
    29→	env.InitRepo()
    30→
    31→	// Create initial commit
    32→	env.WriteFile("main.go", "package main\n")
    33→	env.GitAdd("main.go")
    34→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
    35→
    36→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
    37→
    38→	initialHead := env.GetHeadHash()
    39→	t.Logf("Initial HEAD: %s", initialHead[:7])
    40→
    41→	// ========================================
    42→	// CHECKPOINT 1: Agent adds function
    43→	// ========================================
    44→	t.Log("Creating checkpoint 1 (agent adds function)")
    45→
    46→	session := env.NewSession()
    47→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
    48→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (prompt 1) failed: %v", err)
    49→	}
    50→
    51→	// Agent adds 4 lines
    52→	checkpoint1Content := "package main\n\nfunc agentFunc() {\n\treturn 42\n}\n"
    53→	env.WriteFile("main.go", checkpoint1Content)
    54→
    55→	session.CreateTranscript(
    56→		"Add agent function",
    57→		[]FileChange{{Path: "main.go", Content: checkpoint1Content}},
    58→	)
    59→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
    60→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 1) failed: %v", err)
    61→	}
    62→
    63→	// ========================================
    64→	// USER EDITS between checkpoints
    65→	// ========================================
    66→	t.Log("User makes edits between checkpoints")
    67→
    68→	// User adds 5 comment lines
    69→	userContent := checkpoint1Content +
    70→		"// User comment 1\n" +
    71→		"// User comment 2\n" +
    72→		"// User comment 3\n" +
    73→		"// User comment 4\n" +
    74→		"// User comment 5\n"
    75→	env.WriteFile("main.go", userContent)
    76→

    78→	// CHECKPOINT 2: New prompt (attribution calculated)
    79→	// ========================================
    80→	t.Log("User enters new prompt (attribution should capture 5 user lines)")
    81→
    82→	// Simulate UserPromptSubmit hook - this calculates attribution at prompt start
    83→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
    84→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (prompt 2) failed: %v", err)
    85→	}

    89→	env.WriteFile("main.go", checkpoint2Content)
    90→
    91→	session.CreateTranscript(
    92→		"Add second agent function",
    93→		[]FileChange{{Path: "main.go", Content: checkpoint2Content}},
    94→	)
    95→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
    96→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 2) failed: %v", err)
    97→	}
    98→
    99→	// Verify 2 rewind points
   100→	points := env.GetRewindPoints()
   101→	if len(points) != 2 {
   102→		t.Fatalf("Expected 2 rewind points, got %d", len(points))
   103→	}

   105→	// ========================================
   106→	// USER COMMITS: Condensation happens
   107→	// ========================================
   108→	t.Log("User commits (condensation should happen)")

   354→// TestManualCommit_AttributionNoDoubleCount tests that PromptAttributions are
   355→// cleared after condensation to prevent double-counting on subsequent commits.
   356→//
   357→// Bug scenario:
   358→// 1. Checkpoint 1 → user edits → commit (condensation, PromptAttributions used)
   359→// 2. StepCount reset to 0, but PromptAttributions NOT cleared
   360→// 3. Checkpoint 2 → new PromptAttributions appended to old ones
   361→// 4. Second commit → CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated sums ALL PromptAttributions
   362→// 5. User edits from first commit are double-counted
   363→func TestManualCommit_AttributionNoDoubleCount(t *testing.T) {
   364→	env := NewTestEnv(t)
   365→	defer env.Cleanup()
   366→
   367→	env.InitRepo()
   368→
   369→	// Create initial commit
   370→	env.WriteFile("main.go", "package main\n")
   371→	env.GitAdd("main.go")
   372→	env.GitCommit("Initial commit")
   373→
   374→	env.InitEntire(strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   375→
   376→	// ========================================
   377→	// FIRST CYCLE: Checkpoint → user edit → commit
   378→	// ========================================
   379→	t.Log("First cycle: agent checkpoint + user edit + commit")
   380→
   381→	session := env.NewSession()
   382→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   383→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (first cycle) failed: %v", err)
   384→	}
   385→
   386→	// Agent adds 5 lines
   387→	checkpoint1Content := "package main\n\nfunc agent1() { return 1 }\nfunc agent2() { return 2 }\nfunc agent3() { return 3 }\n"
   388→	env.WriteFile("main.go", checkpoint1Content)
   389→
   390→	session.CreateTranscript(
   391→		"Add agent functions",
   392→		[]FileChange{{Path: "main.go", Content: checkpoint1Content}},
   393→	)
   394→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   395→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (first cycle) failed: %v", err)
   396→	}
   397→
   398→	// User adds 2 lines between checkpoints
   399→	userEdit1Content := checkpoint1Content + "// User comment 1\n// User comment 2\n"
   400→	env.WriteFile("main.go", userEdit1Content)
   401→
   402→	// Commit with hooks (condensation happens)
   403→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("First commit", "main.go")
   404→
   405→	// Get first commit's checkpoint ID
   406→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(env.RepoDir)
   407→	if err != nil {
   408→		t.Fatalf("failed to open repo: %v", err)
   409→	}
   410→
   411→	head, err := repo.Head()
   412→	if err != nil {
   413→		t.Fatalf("failed to get HEAD: %v", err)
   414→	}
   415→
   416→	commit1, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   417→	if err != nil {
   418→		t.Fatalf("failed to get commit: %v", err)
   419→	}
   420→
   421→	checkpointID1, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit1.Message)
   422→	if !found {
   423→		t.Fatal("First commit should have checkpoint trailer")
   424→	}
   425→
   426→	t.Logf("First commit checkpoint ID: %s", checkpointID1)
   427→
   428→	// Verify first commit attribution
   429→	attr1 := getAttributionFromMetadata(t, repo, checkpointID1)
   430→	t.Logf("First commit attribution: agent=%d, human_added=%d, total=%d",
   431→		attr1.AgentLines, attr1.HumanAdded, attr1.TotalCommitted)
   432→
   433→	// First commit should have:
   434→	// - Agent: 4 lines (3 functions + 1 blank)
   435→	// - User: 2 lines (2 comments)
   436→	// - Total: 6 lines
   437→	if attr1.HumanAdded != 2 {
   438→		t.Errorf("First commit HumanAdded = %d, want 2", attr1.HumanAdded)
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	// ========================================
   442→	// SECOND CYCLE: New checkpoint → user edit → commit
   443→	// ========================================
   444→	t.Log("Second cycle: new agent checkpoint + user edit + commit")
   445→
   446→	// Simulate new prompt (should calculate attribution, which should be empty after reset)
   447→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   448→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (second cycle) failed: %v", err)
   449→	}
   450→
   451→	// Agent adds 3 more lines
   452→	checkpoint2Content := userEdit1Content + "\nfunc agent4() { return 4 }\nfunc agent5() { return 5 }\n"
   453→	env.WriteFile("main.go", checkpoint2Content)
   454→
   455→	session.CreateTranscript(
   456→		"Add more agent functions",
   457→		[]FileChange{{Path: "main.go", Content: checkpoint2Content}},
   458→	)
   459→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   460→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (second cycle) failed: %v", err)
   461→	}
   462→
   463→	// User adds 1 more line
   464→	userEdit2Content := checkpoint2Content + "// User comment 3\n"
   465→	env.WriteFile("main.go", userEdit2Content)
   466→
   467→	// Second commit (another condensation)
   468→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Second commit", "main.go")
   469→
   470→	// Get second commit's checkpoint ID
   471→	head, err = repo.Head()
   472→	if err != nil {
   473→		t.Fatalf("failed to get HEAD after second commit: %v", err)
   474→	}
   475→
   476→	commit2, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   477→	if err != nil {
   478→		t.Fatalf("failed to get second commit: %v", err)
   479→	}
   480→
   481→	checkpointID2, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit2.Message)
   482→	if !found {
   483→		t.Fatal("Second commit should have checkpoint trailer")
   484→	}
   485→
   486→	t.Logf("Second commit checkpoint ID: %s", checkpointID2)
   487→
   488→	// Verify second commit attribution
   489→	attr2 := getAttributionFromMetadata(t, repo, checkpointID2)
   490→	t.Logf("Second commit attribution: agent=%d, human_added=%d, total=%d",
   491→		attr2.AgentLines, attr2.HumanAdded, attr2.TotalCommitted)
   492→
   493→	// Second commit should have (since first commit):
   494→	// - Agent: 3 lines (2 functions + 1 blank)
   495→	// - User: 1 line (1 comment)
   496→	// - Total: 4 lines
   497→	//
   498→	// BUG (if not fixed): HumanAdded would be 3 (1 new + 2 from first commit double-counted)
   499→	// CORRECT (after fix): HumanAdded should be 1 (only new user edits)
   500→
   501→	if attr2.HumanAdded != 1 {
   502→		t.Errorf("Second commit HumanAdded = %d, want 1 (should NOT double-count first commit's 2 user lines)",
   503→			attr2.HumanAdded)
   504→	}
   505→
   506→	if attr2.TotalCommitted != 4 {
   507→		t.Errorf("Second commit TotalCommitted = %d, want 4 (3 agent + 1 user)",
   508→			attr2.TotalCommitted)
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	// Agent percentage should be 3/4 = 75%
   512→	if attr2.AgentPercentage < 74.9 || attr2.AgentPercentage > 75.1 {
   513→		t.Errorf("Second commit AgentPercentage = %.1f%%, want 75.0%%", attr2.AgentPercentage)
   514→	}
   515→}

    14→// TestDualStrategy_NoCheckpointForNoChanges verifies that the auto-commit strategy
    15→// does NOT create a checkpoint when a prompt results in no file changes,
    16→// even after a previous prompt that DID create file changes.
    17→//
    18→// This is the fix for ENT-70: auto-commit strategy was incorrectly triggering checkpoints
    19→// because it parsed the entire transcript including file changes from previous prompts.
    20→func TestDualStrategy_NoCheckpointForNoChanges(t *testing.T) {
    21→	t.Parallel()
    22→
    23→	// Only run for auto-commit strategy
    24→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit)
    25→
    26→	// Create a session
    27→	session := env.NewSession()
    28→
    29→	// === FIRST PROMPT: Creates a file ===
    30→	err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID)
    31→	if err != nil {
    32→		t.Fatalf("First SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
    33→	}
    34→
    35→	// Create a file (as if Claude Code wrote it)
    36→	env.WriteFile("feature.go", "package feature\n\nfunc Hello() {}\n")
    37→
    38→	// Create transcript for first prompt
    39→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("Create a hello function")
    40→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("I'll create that for you.")
    41→	toolID := session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolUse("mcp__acp__Write", "feature.go", "package feature\n\nfunc Hello() {}\n")
    42→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddToolResult(toolID)
    43→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("Done!")
    44→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
    45→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
    46→	}
    47→
    48→	// Get head hash before first stop
    49→	hashBeforeFirstStop := env.GetHeadHash()
    50→
    51→	// Simulate stop for first prompt
    52→	err = env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath)
    53→	if err != nil {
    54→		t.Fatalf("First SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
    55→	}
    56→
    57→	// Verify a commit was created (auto-commit creates commits on active branch)
    58→	hashAfterFirstStop := env.GetHeadHash()
    59→	if hashAfterFirstStop == hashBeforeFirstStop {
    60→		t.Error("Expected commit to be created after first prompt with file changes")
    61→	}
    62→
    63→	// === SECOND PROMPT: No file changes ===
    64→	err = env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID)
    65→	if err != nil {
    66→		t.Fatalf("Second SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
    67→	}
    68→
    69→	// Add second prompt to transcript (no file changes this time)
    70→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddUserMessage("What does the Hello function do?")
    71→	session.TranscriptBuilder.AddAssistantMessage("The Hello function is currently empty. It doesn't do anything yet.")
    72→	if err := session.TranscriptBuilder.WriteToFile(session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
    73→		t.Fatalf("Failed to write transcript: %v", err)
    74→	}
    75→
    76→	// Simulate stop for second prompt
    77→	err = env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath)
    78→	if err != nil {
    79→		t.Fatalf("Second SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
    80→	}
    81→
    82→	// Verify NO new commit was created (this is the bug fix!)
    83→	hashAfterSecondStop := env.GetHeadHash()
    84→	if hashAfterSecondStop != hashAfterFirstStop {
    85→		t.Errorf("No commit should be created for prompt without file changes.\nHash after first stop: %s\nHash after second stop: %s",
    86→			hashAfterFirstStop, hashAfterSecondStop)
    87→	}

   167→		return true
   168→	}
   169→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "REVERT_HEAD")); err == nil {
   170→		return true
   171→	}
   172→
   173→	return false
   174→}

   176→// PrepareCommitMsg is called by the git prepare-commit-msg hook.
   177→// Adds an Entire-Checkpoint trailer to the commit message with a stable checkpoint ID.
   178→// Only adds a trailer if there's actually new session content to condense.
   179→// The actual condensation happens in PostCommit - if the user removes the trailer,
   180→// the commit will not be linked to the session (useful for "manual" commits).
   181→// For amended commits, preserves the existing checkpoint ID.
   182→//
   183→// The source parameter indicates how the commit was initiated:
   184→//   - "" or "template": normal editor flow - adds trailer with explanatory comment
   185→//   - "message": using -m or -F flag - prompts user interactively via /dev/tty
   186→//   - "merge", "squash": skip trailer entirely (auto-generated messages)
   187→//   - "commit": amend operation - preserves existing trailer or restores from PendingCheckpointID
   188→//
   189→
   190→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PrepareCommitMsg(commitMsgFile string, source string) error {
   191→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   192→
   193→	// Skip during rebase, cherry-pick, or revert operations
   194→	// These are replaying existing commits and should not be linked to agent sessions
   195→	if isGitSequenceOperation() {
   196→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped during git sequence operation",
   197→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   198→			slog.String("source", source),
   199→		)
   200→		return nil
   201→	}
   202→
   203→	// Skip for merge and squash sources
   204→	// These are auto-generated messages - not from Claude sessions
   205→	switch source {
   206→	case "merge", "squash":
   207→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped for source",
   208→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   209→			slog.String("source", source),
   210→		)
   211→		return nil
   212→	}
   213→
   214→	// Handle amend (source="commit") separately: preserve or restore trailer
   215→	if source == "commit" {
   216→		return s.handleAmendCommitMsg(logCtx, commitMsgFile)
   217→	}
   218→
   219→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   220→	if err != nil {
   221→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   222→	}
   223→
   224→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   225→	if err != nil {
   226→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   227→	}
   228→
   229→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   230→	// We match by worktree (not BaseCommit) because the user may have made
   231→	// intermediate commits without entering new prompts, causing HEAD to diverge
   232→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   233→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   234→		// No active sessions or error listing - silently skip (hooks must be resilient)
   235→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no active sessions",
   236→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   237→			slog.String("source", source),
   238→		)
   239→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	// Check if any session has new content to condense
   243→	sessionsWithContent := s.filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo, sessions)
   244→
   245→	// Determine which checkpoint ID to use
   246→	var checkpointID id.CheckpointID
   247→	var hasNewContent bool
   248→	var reusedSession *SessionState
   249→
   250→	if len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   251→		// New content exists - will generate new checkpoint ID below
   252→		hasNewContent = true
   253→	} else {
   254→		// No new content - check if any session has a LastCheckpointID to reuse
   255→		// This handles the case where user splits Claude's work across multiple commits
   256→		// Reuse if: LastCheckpointID exists AND (FilesTouched is empty OR files overlap)
   257→		// - FilesTouched empty: commits made before session stop, reuse checkpoint
   258→		// - FilesTouched populated: only reuse if files overlap (prevents unrelated commits from reusing)
   259→
   260→		// Get current HEAD to filter sessions
   261→		head, err := repo.Head()
   262→		if err != nil {
   263→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   264→		}
   265→		currentHeadHash := head.Hash().String()
   266→
   267→		// Filter to sessions where BaseCommit matches current HEAD
   268→		// This prevents reusing checkpoint IDs from old sessions
   269→		// Note: BaseCommit is kept current both when new content is condensed (in the
   270→		// condensation process) and when no new content is found (via PostCommit when
   271→		// reusing checkpoint IDs). If none match, we don't add a trailer rather than
   272→		// falling back to old sessions which could have stale checkpoint IDs.
   273→		var currentSessions []*SessionState
   274→		for _, session := range sessions {
   275→			if session.BaseCommit == currentHeadHash {
   276→				currentSessions = append(currentSessions, session)
   277→			}
   278→		}
   279→
   280→		if len(currentSessions) == 0 {
   281→			// No sessions match current HEAD - don't try to reuse checkpoint IDs
   282→			// from old sessions as they may be stale
   283→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no sessions match current HEAD",
   284→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   285→				slog.String("source", source),
   286→				slog.String("current_head", currentHeadHash[:7]),
   287→				slog.Int("total_sessions", len(sessions)),
   288→			)
   289→			return nil
   290→		}
   291→
   292→		stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo)
   293→		for _, session := range currentSessions {
   294→			if !session.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() &&
   295→				(len(session.FilesTouched) == 0 || hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, session.FilesTouched)) {
   296→				checkpointID = session.LastCheckpointID
   297→				reusedSession = session
   298→				break
   299→			}
   300→		}
   301→		if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   302→			// No new content and no previous checkpoint to reference (or staged files are unrelated)
   303→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no content to link",
   304→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   305→				slog.String("source", source),
   306→				slog.Int("sessions_found", len(sessions)),
   307→				slog.Int("sessions_with_content", len(sessionsWithContent)),
   308→			)
   309→			return nil
   310→		}
   311→	}
   312→
   313→	// Read current commit message
   314→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   315→	if err != nil {
   316→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   317→	}
   318→
   319→	message := string(content)
   320→
   321→	// Get or generate checkpoint ID (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   322→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   323→		// Trailer already exists (e.g., amend) - keep it
   324→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer already exists",
   325→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   326→			slog.String("source", source),
   327→			slog.String("existing_checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   328→		)
   329→		return nil
   330→	}
   331→
   332→	if hasNewContent {
   333→		// New content: check PendingCheckpointID first (set during previous condensation),
   334→		// otherwise generate a new one. This ensures idempotent IDs across hook invocations.
   335→		for _, state := range sessionsWithContent {
   336→			if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
   337→				if cpID, err := id.NewCheckpointID(state.PendingCheckpointID); err == nil {
   338→					checkpointID = cpID
   339→					break
   340→				}
   341→			}
   342→		}
   343→		if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   344→			cpID, err := id.Generate()
   345→			if err != nil {
   346→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   347→			}
   348→			checkpointID = cpID
   349→		}
   350→	}
   351→	// Otherwise checkpointID is already set to LastCheckpointID from above
   352→
   353→	// Determine agent type and last prompt from session
   354→	agentType := DefaultAgentType // default for backward compatibility
   355→	var lastPrompt string
   356→	if hasNewContent && len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   357→		session := sessionsWithContent[0]
   358→		if session.AgentType != "" {
   359→			agentType = session.AgentType
   360→		}
   361→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(repo, session)
   362→	} else if reusedSession != nil {
   363→		// Reusing checkpoint from existing session - get agent type and prompt from that session
   364→		if reusedSession.AgentType != "" {
   365→			agentType = reusedSession.AgentType
   366→		}
   367→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(repo, reusedSession)
   368→	}
   369→
   370→	// Prepare prompt for display: collapse newlines/whitespace, then truncate (rune-safe)
   371→	displayPrompt := stringutil.TruncateRunes(stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(lastPrompt), 80, "...")
   372→
   373→	// Check if we're restoring an existing checkpoint ID (already condensed)
   374→	// vs linking a genuinely new checkpoint. Restoring doesn't need user confirmation
   375→	// since the data is already committed — this handles git commit --amend -m "..."
   376→	// and non-interactive environments (e.g., Claude doing commits).
   377→	isRestoringExisting := false
   378→	if !hasNewContent && reusedSession != nil {
   379→		// Reusing LastCheckpointID from a previous condensation
   380→		isRestoringExisting = true
   381→	} else if hasNewContent {
   382→		for _, state := range sessionsWithContent {
   383→			if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
   384→				isRestoringExisting = true
   385→				break
   386→			}
   387→		}
   388→	}
   389→
   390→	// Add trailer differently based on commit source
   391→	switch {
   392→	case source == "message" && !isRestoringExisting:
   393→		// Using -m or -F with genuinely new content: ask user interactively
   394→		// whether to add trailer (comments won't be stripped by git in this mode)
   395→
   396→		// Build context string for interactive prompt
   397→		var promptContext string
   398→		if displayPrompt != "" {
   399→			promptContext = "You have an active " + string(agentType) + " session.\nLast Prompt: " + displayPrompt
   400→		}
   401→
   402→		if !askConfirmTTY("Link this commit to "+string(agentType)+" session context?", promptContext, true) {
   403→			// User declined - don't add trailer
   404→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: user declined trailer",
   405→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   406→				slog.String("source", source),
   407→			)
   408→			return nil
   409→		}
   410→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   411→	case source == "message":
   412→		// Restoring existing checkpoint ID (amend, split commit, or non-interactive)
   413→		// No confirmation needed — data is already condensed
   414→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   415→	default:
   416→		// Normal editor flow: add trailer with explanatory comment (will be stripped by git)
   417→		message = addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message, checkpointID, string(agentType), displayPrompt)
   418→	}
   419→
   420→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer added",
   421→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   422→		slog.String("source", source),
   423→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   424→		slog.Bool("has_new_content", hasNewContent),
   425→	)
   426→
   427→	// Write updated message back
   428→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   429→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   430→	}
   431→
   432→	return nil
   433→}
   434→
   435→// handleAmendCommitMsg handles the prepare-commit-msg hook for amend operations
   436→// (source="commit"). It preserves existing trailers or restores from PendingCheckpointID.
   437→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) handleAmendCommitMsg(logCtx context.Context, commitMsgFile string) error {
   438→	// Read current commit message
   439→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   440→	if err != nil {
   441→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   442→	}
   443→
   444→	message := string(content)
   445→
   446→	// If message already has a trailer, keep it unchanged
   447→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   448→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend preserves existing trailer",
   449→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   450→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   451→		)
   452→		return nil
   453→	}
   454→
   455→	// No trailer in message — check if any session has PendingCheckpointID to restore
   456→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   457→	if err != nil {
   458→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   462→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   463→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions - nothing to restore
   464→	}
   465→
   466→	// Find first session with PendingCheckpointID
   467→	for _, state := range sessions {
   468→		if state.PendingCheckpointID == "" {
   469→			continue
   470→		}
   471→
   472→		cpID, err := id.NewCheckpointID(state.PendingCheckpointID)
   473→		if err != nil {
   474→			continue // Invalid ID, skip
   475→		}
   476→
   477→		// Restore the trailer
   478→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
   479→		if writeErr := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); writeErr != nil {
   480→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   481→		}
   482→
   483→		logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: restored trailer on amend from PendingCheckpointID",
   484→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   485→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
   486→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   487→		)
   488→		return nil
   489→	}
   490→
   491→	// No PendingCheckpointID found - leave message unchanged
   492→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend with no pending checkpoint to restore",
   493→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   494→	)
   495→	return nil
   496→}
   497→
   498→// PostCommit is called by the git post-commit hook after a commit is created.
   499→// Uses the session state machine to determine what action to take per session:
   500→//   - ACTIVE → ACTIVE_COMMITTED: defer condensation (agent still working)
   501→//   - IDLE → condense immediately
   502→//   - ACTIVE_COMMITTED → migrate shadow branch (additional commit during same turn)
   503→//   - ENDED → condense if files touched, discard if empty
   504→//
   505→// Shadow branches are only deleted when ALL sessions sharing the branch are non-active.
   506→// During rebase/cherry-pick/revert operations, phase transitions are skipped entirely.
   507→//
   508→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
   509→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit() error {
   510→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   511→
   512→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   513→	if err != nil {
   514→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   515→	}
   516→
   517→	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
   518→	head, err := repo.Head()
   519→	if err != nil {
   520→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   521→	}
   522→
   523→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   524→	if err != nil {
   525→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   526→	}
   527→
   528→	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   529→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   530→	if !found {
   531→		// No trailer - user removed it, treat as manual commit
   532→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: no checkpoint trailer",
   533→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   534→		)
   535→		return nil
   536→	}
   537→
   538→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   539→	if err != nil {
   540→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   544→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   545→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   546→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: no active sessions despite trailer",
   547→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   548→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   549→		)
   550→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   551→	}
   552→
   553→	// Build transition context
   554→	isRebase := isGitSequenceOperation()
   555→	transitionCtx := session.TransitionContext{
   556→		IsRebaseInProgress: isRebase,
   557→	}
   558→
   559→	if isRebase {
   560→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: rebase/sequence in progress, skipping phase transitions",
   561→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   562→		)
   563→	}
   564→
   565→	// Track shadow branch names and whether they can be deleted
   566→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   567→	// Track sessions that are still active AFTER transitions
   568→	activeSessionsOnBranch := make(map[string]bool)
   569→
   570→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   571→
   572→	// Two-pass processing: condensation first, migration second.
   573→	// This prevents a migration from renaming a shadow branch before another
   574→	// session sharing that branch has had a chance to condense from it.
   575→	type pendingMigration struct {
   576→		state *SessionState
   577→	}
   578→	var pendingMigrations []pendingMigration
   579→
   580→	// Pass 1: Run transitions and dispatch condensation/discard actions.
   581→	// Defer migration actions to pass 2.
   582→	for _, state := range sessions {
   583→		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   584→
   585→		// Check for new content (needed for TransitionContext and condensation).
   586→		// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content exists so we
   587→		// don't silently skip data that should have been condensed.
   588→		hasNew, contentErr := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   589→		if contentErr != nil {
   590→			hasNew = true
   591→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: error checking session content, assuming new content",
   592→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   593→				slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()),
   594→			)
   595→		}
   596→		transitionCtx.HasFilesTouched = len(state.FilesTouched) > 0
   597→
   598→		// Run the state machine transition
   599→		remaining := TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventGitCommit, transitionCtx)
   600→
   601→		// Dispatch strategy-specific actions.
   602→		// Each branch handles its own BaseCommit update so there is no
   603→		// fallthrough conditional at the end. On condensation failure,
   604→		// BaseCommit is intentionally NOT updated to preserve access to
   605→		// the shadow branch (which is named after the old BaseCommit).
   606→		for _, action := range remaining {
   607→			switch action {
   608→			case session.ActionCondense:
   609→				if hasNew {
   610→					s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   611→					// condenseAndUpdateState updates BaseCommit on success.
   612→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved so the shadow branch remains accessible.
   613→				} else {
   614→					// No new content to condense — just update BaseCommit
   615→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   616→				}
   617→			case session.ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched:
   618→				// The state machine already gates this action on HasFilesTouched,
   619→				// but hasNew is an additional content-level check (transcript has
   620→				// new content beyond what was previously condensed).
   621→				if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 && hasNew {
   622→					s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   623→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved (same as ActionCondense).
   624→				} else {
   625→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   626→				}
   627→			case session.ActionDiscardIfNoFiles:
   628→				if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   629→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: skipping empty ended session (no files to condense)",
   630→						slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   631→					)
   632→				}
   633→				s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   634→			case session.ActionMigrateShadowBranch:
   635→				// Deferred to pass 2 so condensation reads the old shadow branch first.
   636→				// Migration updates BaseCommit as part of the rename.
   637→				// Store checkpointID so HandleTurnEnd can reuse it for deferred condensation.
   638→				state.PendingCheckpointID = checkpointID.String()
   639→				pendingMigrations = append(pendingMigrations, pendingMigration{state: state})
   640→			case session.ActionClearEndedAt, session.ActionUpdateLastInteraction:
   641→				// Handled by session.ApplyCommonActions above
   642→			case session.ActionWarnStaleSession:
   643→				// Not produced by EventGitCommit; listed for switch exhaustiveness
   644→			}
   645→		}
   646→
   647→		// Save the updated state
   648→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   649→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   650→		}
   651→
   652→		// Track whether any session on this shadow branch is still active
   653→		if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   654→			activeSessionsOnBranch[shadowBranchName] = true
   655→		}
   656→	}
   657→
   658→	// Pass 2: Run deferred migrations now that all condensations are complete.
   659→	for _, pm := range pendingMigrations {
   660→		if _, migErr := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, pm.state); migErr != nil {
   661→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: shadow branch migration failed",
   662→				slog.String("session_id", pm.state.SessionID),
   663→				slog.String("error", migErr.Error()),
   664→			)
   665→		}
   666→		// Save the migrated state
   667→		if err := s.saveSessionState(pm.state); err != nil {
   668→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state after migration: %v\n", err)
   669→		}
   670→	}
   671→
   672→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active
   673→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   674→		if activeSessionsOnBranch[shadowBranchName] {
   675→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: preserving shadow branch (active session exists)",
   676→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   677→			)
   678→			continue
   679→		}
   680→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   681→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to clean up %s: %v\n", shadowBranchName, err)
   682→		} else {
   683→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Cleaned up shadow branch: %s\n", shadowBranchName)
   684→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   685→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   686→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   687→			)
   688→		}
   689→	}
   690→
   691→	return nil
   692→}

   694→// condenseAndUpdateState runs condensation for a session and updates state afterward.
   695→// Returns true if condensation succeeded.
   696→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) condenseAndUpdateState(
   697→	logCtx context.Context,
   698→	repo *git.Repository,
   699→	checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   700→	state *SessionState,
   701→	head *plumbing.Reference,
   702→	shadowBranchName string,
   703→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{},
   704→) {
   705→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
   706→	if err != nil {
   707→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: condensation failed for session %s: %v\n",
   708→			state.SessionID, err)
   709→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: condensation failed",
   710→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   711→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   712→		)
   713→		return
   714→	}
   715→
   716→	// Track this shadow branch for cleanup
   717→	shadowBranchesToDelete[shadowBranchName] = struct{}{}
   718→
   719→	// Update session state for the new base commit
   720→	state.BaseCommit = head.Hash().String()
   721→	state.StepCount = 0
   722→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   723→
   724→	// Clear attribution tracking — condensation already used these values
   725→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   726→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   727→
   728→	// Save checkpoint ID so subsequent commits can reuse it
   729→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   730→	// Set PendingCheckpointID for amend trailer restoration
   731→	state.PendingCheckpointID = checkpointID.String()
   732→
   733→	shortID := state.SessionID
   734→	if len(shortID) > 8 {
   735→		shortID = shortID[:8]
   736→	}
   737→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Condensed session %s: %s (%d checkpoints)\n",
   738→		shortID, result.CheckpointID, result.CheckpointsCount)
   739→
   740→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed",
   741→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   742→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   743→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   744→		slog.Int("transcript_lines", result.TotalTranscriptLines),
   745→	)
   746→}

   759→// filterSessionsWithNewContent returns sessions that have new transcript content
   760→// beyond what was already condensed.
   761→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo *git.Repository, sessions []*SessionState) []*SessionState {
   762→	var result []*SessionState
   763→
   764→	for _, state := range sessions {
   765→		hasNew, err := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   766→		if err != nil {
   767→			// On error, include the session (fail open for hooks)
   768→			result = append(result, state)
   769→			continue
   770→		}
   771→		if hasNew {
   772→			result = append(result, state)
   773→		}
   774→	}
   775→
   776→	return result
   777→}

   779→// sessionHasNewContent checks if a session has new transcript content
   780→// beyond what was already condensed.
   781→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContent(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   782→	// Get shadow branch
   783→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   784→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   785→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   786→	if err != nil {
   787→		// No shadow branch means no Stop has happened since the last condensation.
   788→		// However, the agent may have done work (including commits) without a Stop.
   789→		// Check the live transcript to detect this scenario.
   790→		return s.sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo, state)
   791→	}
   792→
   793→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   794→	if err != nil {
   795→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   796→	}
   797→
   798→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   799→	if err != nil {
   800→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   801→	}
   802→
   803→	// Look for transcript file
   804→	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + state.SessionID
   805→	var transcriptLines int
   806→
   807→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   808→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   809→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   810→		}
   811→	} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   812→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   813→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   814→		}
   815→	}
   816→
   817→	// Has new content if there are more lines than already condensed
   818→	return transcriptLines > state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, nil
   819→}
   820→
   821→// countTranscriptLines counts lines in a transcript, matching the counting method used
   822→// in extractSessionData for consistency. This trims trailing empty lines (from final \n
   823→// in JSONL) but includes empty lines in the middle of the file.
   824→func countTranscriptLines(content string) int {
   825→	lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   826→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   827→	for len(lines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(lines[len(lines)-1]) == "" {
   828→		lines = lines[:len(lines)-1]
   829→	}
   830→	return len(lines)
   831→}
   832→
   833→// sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript checks if a session has new content
   834→// by examining the live transcript file. This is used when no shadow branch exists
   835→// (i.e., no Stop has happened yet) but the agent may have done work.
   836→//
   837→// Returns true if:
   838→//  1. The transcript has grown since the last condensation, AND
   839→//  2. The new transcript portion contains file modifications, AND
   840→//  3. At least one modified file overlaps with the currently staged files
   841→//
   842→// The overlap check ensures we don't add checkpoint trailers to commits that are
   843→// unrelated to the agent's recent changes.
   844→//
   845→// This handles the scenario where the agent commits mid-session before Stop.
   846→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   847→	// Need both transcript path and agent type to analyze
   848→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" || state.AgentType == "" {
   849→		return false, nil
   850→	}
   851→
   852→	// Get the agent for transcript analysis
   853→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
   854→	if err != nil {
   855→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Unknown agent type, fail gracefully
   856→	}
   857→
   858→	// Cast to TranscriptAnalyzer
   859→	analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer)
   860→	if !ok {
   861→		return false, nil // Agent doesn't support transcript analysis
   862→	}
   863→
   864→	// Get current transcript position
   865→	currentPos, err := analyzer.GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)
   866→	if err != nil {
   867→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error reading transcript, fail gracefully
   868→	}
   869→
   870→	// Check if transcript has grown since last condensation
   871→	if currentPos <= state.CheckpointTranscriptStart {
   872→		return false, nil // No new content
   873→	}
   874→
   875→	// Transcript has grown - check if there are file modifications in the new portion
   876→	modifiedFiles, _, err := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   877→	if err != nil {
   878→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error parsing transcript, fail gracefully
   879→	}
   880→
   881→	// No file modifications means no new content to checkpoint
   882→	if len(modifiedFiles) == 0 {
   883→		return false, nil
   884→	}
   885→
   886→	// Check if any modified files overlap with currently staged files
   887→	// This ensures we only add checkpoint trailers to commits that include
   888→	// files the agent actually modified
   889→	stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo) // TODO: does it work? Do we have staged files if this is called at post-commit hook ?
   890→	if !hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, modifiedFiles) {
   891→		return false, nil // No overlap - staged files are unrelated to agent's work
   892→	}
   893→
   894→	return true, nil
   895→}

   897→// addCheckpointTrailer adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer to a commit message.
   898→// Handles proper trailer formatting (blank line before trailers if needed).
   899→func addCheckpointTrailer(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) string {
   900→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
   901→
   902→	// If message already ends with trailers (lines starting with key:), just append
   903→	// Otherwise, add a blank line first
   904→	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(message, "\n"), "\n")
   905→
   906→	// Check if last non-empty, non-comment line looks like a trailer
   907→	// Git comment lines start with # and may contain ": " (e.g., "# Changes to be committed:")
   908→	hasTrailers := false
   909→	for i := len(lines) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   910→		line := strings.TrimSpace(lines[i])
   911→		if line == "" {
   912→			break
   913→		}
   914→		// Skip git comment lines
   915→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
   916→			continue
   917→		}
   918→		if strings.Contains(line, ": ") {
   919→			hasTrailers = true
   920→			break
   921→		}
   922→		// Non-comment, non-trailer line found - no existing trailers
   923→		break
   924→	}
   925→
   926→	if hasTrailers {
   927→		// Append trailer directly
   928→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n" + trailer + "\n"
   929→	}
   930→
   931→	// Add blank line before trailer
   932→	return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n"
   933→}
   934→
   935→// addCheckpointTrailerWithComment adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer with an explanatory comment.
   936→// The trailer is placed above the git comment block but below the user's message area,
   937→// with a comment explaining that the user can remove it if they don't want to link the commit
   938→// to the agent session. If prompt is non-empty, it's shown as context.
   939→func addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, agentName, prompt string) string {
   940→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
   941→	commentLines := []string{
   942→		"# Remove the Entire-Checkpoint trailer above if you don't want to link this commit to " + agentName + " session context.",
   943→	}
   944→	if prompt != "" {
   945→		commentLines = append(commentLines, "# Last Prompt: "+prompt)
   946→	}
   947→	commentLines = append(commentLines, "# The trailer will be added to your next commit based on this branch.")
   948→	comment := strings.Join(commentLines, "\n")
   949→
   950→	lines := strings.Split(message, "\n")
   951→
   952→	// Find where the git comment block starts (first # line)
   953→	commentStart := -1
   954→	for i, line := range lines {
   955→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
   956→			commentStart = i
   957→			break
   958→		}
   959→	}
   960→
   961→	if commentStart == -1 {
   962→		// No git comments, append trailer at the end
   963→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n"
   964→	}
   965→
   966→	// Split into user content and git comments
   967→	userContent := strings.Join(lines[:commentStart], "\n")
   968→	gitComments := strings.Join(lines[commentStart:], "\n")
   969→
   970→	// Build result: user content, blank line, trailer, comment, blank line, git comments
   971→	userContent = strings.TrimRight(userContent, "\n")
   972→	if userContent == "" {
   973→		// No user content yet - leave space for them to type, then trailer
   974→		// Two newlines: first for user's message line, second for blank separator
   975→		return "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
   976→	}
   977→	return userContent + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
   978→}
