   980→// InitializeSession creates session state for a new session or updates an existing one.
   981→// This implements the optional SessionInitializer interface.
   982→// Called during UserPromptSubmit to allow git hooks to detect active sessions.
   983→//
   984→// If the session already exists and HEAD has moved (e.g., user committed), updates
   985→// BaseCommit to the new HEAD so future checkpoints go to the correct shadow branch.
   986→//
   987→// If there's an existing shadow branch with commits from a different session ID,
   988→// returns a SessionIDConflictError to prevent orphaning existing session work.
   989→//
   990→// agentType is the human-readable name of the agent (e.g., "Claude Code").
   991→// transcriptPath is the path to the live transcript file (for mid-session commit detection).
   992→// userPrompt is the user's prompt text (stored truncated as FirstPrompt for display).
   993→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) InitializeSession(sessionID string, agentType agent.AgentType, transcriptPath string, userPrompt string) error {
   994→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   995→	if err != nil {
   996→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   997→	}
   998→
   999→	// Check if session already exists
  1000→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
  1001→	if err != nil {
  1002→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check session state: %w", err)
  1003→	}
  1004→
  1005→	if state != nil && state.BaseCommit != "" {
  1006→		// Session is fully initialized — apply phase transition for TurnStart
  1007→		TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
  1008→
  1009→		// Backfill AgentType if empty or set to the generic default "Agent"
  1010→		if !isSpecificAgentType(state.AgentType) && agentType != "" {
  1011→			state.AgentType = agentType
  1012→		}
  1013→
  1014→		// Backfill FirstPrompt if empty (for sessions created before the first_prompt field was added)
  1015→		if state.FirstPrompt == "" && userPrompt != "" {
  1016→			state.FirstPrompt = truncatePromptForStorage(userPrompt)
  1017→		}
  1018→
  1019→		// Update transcript path if provided (may change on session resume)
  1020→		if transcriptPath != "" && state.TranscriptPath != transcriptPath {
  1021→			state.TranscriptPath = transcriptPath
  1022→		}
  1023→
  1024→		// Clear checkpoint IDs on every new prompt
  1025→		// These are set during PostCommit when a checkpoint is created, and should be
  1026→		// cleared when the user enters a new prompt (starting fresh work)
  1027→		if state.LastCheckpointID != "" {
  1028→			state.LastCheckpointID = ""
  1029→		}
  1030→		if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
  1031→			state.PendingCheckpointID = ""
  1032→		}
  1033→
  1034→		// Calculate attribution at prompt start (BEFORE agent makes any changes)
  1035→		// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint (or base commit for first prompt).
  1036→		// IMPORTANT: Always calculate attribution, even for the first checkpoint, to capture
  1037→		// user edits made before the first prompt. The inner CalculatePromptAttribution handles
  1038→		// nil lastCheckpointTree by falling back to baseTree.
  1039→		promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
  1040→		state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
  1041→
  1042→		// Check if HEAD has moved (user pulled/rebased or committed)
  1043→		// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded handles renaming the shadow branch and updating state.BaseCommit
  1044→		if _, err := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, state); err != nil {
  1045→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check/migrate shadow branch: %w", err)
  1046→		}
  1047→
  1048→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
  1049→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update session state: %w", err)
  1050→		}
  1051→		return nil
  1052→	}
  1053→	// If state exists but BaseCommit is empty, it's a partial state from concurrent warning
  1054→	// Continue below to properly initialize it
  1055→
  1056→	// Initialize new session
  1057→	state, err = s.initializeSession(repo, sessionID, agentType, transcriptPath, userPrompt)
  1058→	if err != nil {
  1059→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize session: %w", err)
  1060→	}
  1061→
  1062→	// Apply phase transition: new session starts as ACTIVE
  1063→	TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
  1064→
  1065→	// Calculate attribution for pre-prompt edits
  1066→	// This captures any user edits made before the first prompt
  1067→	promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
  1068→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
  1069→	if err = s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
  1070→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save attribution: %w", err)
  1071→	}
  1072→
  1073→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Initialized shadow session: %s\n", sessionID)
  1074→	return nil
  1075→}
  1076→
  1077→// calculatePromptAttributionAtStart calculates attribution at prompt start (before agent runs).
  1078→// This captures user changes since the last checkpoint - no filtering needed since
  1079→// the agent hasn't made any changes yet.
  1080→//
  1081→// IMPORTANT: This reads from the worktree (not staging area) to match what WriteTemporary
  1082→// captures in checkpoints. If we read staged content but checkpoints capture worktree content,
  1083→// unstaged changes would be in the checkpoint but not counted in PromptAttribution, causing
  1084→// them to be incorrectly attributed to the agent later.
  1085→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(
  1086→	repo *git.Repository,
  1087→	state *SessionState,
  1088→) PromptAttribution {
  1089→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
  1090→	nextCheckpointNum := state.StepCount + 1
  1091→	result := PromptAttribution{CheckpointNumber: nextCheckpointNum}
  1092→
  1093→	// Get last checkpoint tree from shadow branch (if it exists)
  1094→	// For the first checkpoint, no shadow branch exists yet - this is fine,
  1095→	// CalculatePromptAttribution will use baseTree as the reference instead.
  1096→	var lastCheckpointTree *object.Tree
  1097→	shadowBranchName := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
  1098→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
  1099→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
  1100→	if err != nil {
  1101→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: no shadow branch yet (first checkpoint)",
  1102→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName))
  1103→		// Continue with lastCheckpointTree = nil
  1104→	} else {
  1105→		shadowCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
  1106→		if err != nil {
  1107→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: failed to get shadow commit",
  1108→				slog.String("shadow_ref", ref.Hash().String()),
  1109→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1110→			// Continue with lastCheckpointTree = nil
  1111→		} else {
  1112→			lastCheckpointTree, err = shadowCommit.Tree()
  1113→			if err != nil {
  1114→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: failed to get shadow tree",
  1115→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1116→				// Continue with lastCheckpointTree = nil
  1117→			}
  1118→		}
  1119→	}
  1120→
  1121→	// Get base tree for agent lines calculation
  1122→	var baseTree *object.Tree
  1123→	if baseCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(state.BaseCommit)); err == nil {
  1124→		if tree, treeErr := baseCommit.Tree(); treeErr == nil {
  1125→			baseTree = tree
  1126→		} else {
  1127→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: base tree unavailable",
  1128→				slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
  1129→		}
  1130→	} else {
  1131→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: base commit unavailable",
  1132→			slog.String("base_commit", state.BaseCommit),
  1133→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1134→	}
  1135→
  1136→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
  1137→	if err != nil {
  1138→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution skipped: failed to get worktree",
  1139→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1140→		return result
  1141→	}
  1142→
  1143→	// Get worktree status to find ALL changed files
  1144→	status, err := worktree.Status()
  1145→	if err != nil {
  1146→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution skipped: failed to get worktree status",
  1147→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1148→		return result
  1149→	}
  1150→
  1151→	worktreeRoot := worktree.Filesystem.Root()
  1152→
  1153→	// Build map of changed files with their worktree content
  1154→	// IMPORTANT: We read from worktree (not staging area) to match what WriteTemporary
  1155→	// captures in checkpoints. This ensures attribution is consistent.
  1156→	changedFiles := make(map[string]string)
  1157→	for filePath, fileStatus := range status {
  1158→		// Skip unmodified files
  1159→		if fileStatus.Worktree == git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging == git.Unmodified {
  1160→			continue
  1161→		}
  1162→		// Skip .entire metadata directory (session data, not user code)
  1163→		if strings.HasPrefix(filePath, paths.EntireMetadataDir+"/") || strings.HasPrefix(filePath, ".entire/") {
  1164→			continue
  1165→		}
  1166→
  1167→		// Always read from worktree to match checkpoint behavior
  1168→		fullPath := filepath.Join(worktreeRoot, filePath)
  1169→		var content string
  1170→		if data, err := os.ReadFile(fullPath); err == nil { //nolint:gosec // filePath is from git worktree status
  1171→			// Use git's binary detection algorithm (matches getFileContent behavior).
  1172→			// Binary files are excluded from line-based attribution calculations.
  1173→			isBinary, binErr := binary.IsBinary(bytes.NewReader(data))
  1174→			if binErr == nil && !isBinary {
  1175→				content = string(data)
  1176→			}
  1177→		}
  1178→		// else: file deleted, unreadable, or binary - content remains empty string
  1179→
  1180→		changedFiles[filePath] = content
  1181→	}
  1182→
  1183→	// Use CalculatePromptAttribution from manual_commit_attribution.go
  1184→	result = CalculatePromptAttribution(baseTree, lastCheckpointTree, changedFiles, nextCheckpointNum)
  1185→
  1186→	return result
  1187→}
  1188→
  1189→// getStagedFiles returns a list of files staged for commit.
  1190→func getStagedFiles(repo *git.Repository) []string {
  1191→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
  1192→	if err != nil {
  1193→		return nil
  1194→	}

    38→	// Parse hook input using agent interface

    40→	if err != nil {

    43→
    44→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())

    65→// captureInitialState captures the initial state on user prompt submit.

    90→// commitWithMetadata commits the session changes with metadata.
    91→func commitWithMetadata() error {
    92→	// Skip on default branch for strategies that don't allow it
    93→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranchForStrategy(); skip {
    94→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping on branch '%s' - create a feature branch to use Entire tracking\n", branchName)
    95→		return nil // Don't fail the hook, just skip
    96→	}
    97→
    98→	// Get the agent for hook input parsing and session ID transformation
    99→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   100→	if err != nil {
   101→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   102→	}
   103→
   104→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
   105→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookStop, os.Stdin)
   106→	if err != nil {
   107→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   108→	}
   109→
   110→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   111→	logging.Info(logCtx, "stop",
   112→		slog.String("hook", "stop"),
   113→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   114→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   115→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
   116→	)
   117→
   118→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   119→	if sessionID == "" {
   120→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   121→	}
   122→
   123→	transcriptPath := input.SessionRef
   124→	if transcriptPath == "" || !fileExists(transcriptPath) {
   125→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found or empty: %s", transcriptPath)
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	// Create session metadata folder using the entire session ID (preserves original date on resume)
   129→	// Use AbsPath to ensure we create at repo root, not relative to cwd
   130→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   131→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(sessionDir)
   132→	if err != nil {
   133→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir // Fallback to relative
   134→	}
   135→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   136→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   137→	}
   138→
   139→	// Wait for Claude Code to flush the transcript file.
   140→	// The stop hook fires before the transcript is fully written to disk.
   141→	// We poll for our own hook_progress sentinel entry in the file tail,
   142→	// which guarantees all prior entries have been flushed.
   143→	waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath, time.Now())
   144→
   145→	// Copy transcript
   146→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   147→	if err := copyFile(transcriptPath, logFile); err != nil {
   148→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   149→	}
   150→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copied transcript to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName)
   151→
   152→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on UserPromptSubmit)
   153→	// Needed for transcript offset and file change detection
   154→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(sessionID)
   155→	if err != nil {
   156→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   157→	}
   158→
   159→	// Determine transcript offset: prefer pre-prompt state, fall back to session state.
   160→	// Pre-prompt state has the offset when the transcript path was available at prompt time.
   161→	// Session state has the offset updated after each successful checkpoint save (auto-commit).
   162→	var transcriptOffset int
   163→	if preState != nil && preState.StepTranscriptStart > 0 {
   164→		transcriptOffset = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   165→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   166→	} else {
   167→		// Fall back to session state (e.g., auto-commit strategy updates it after each save)
   168→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   169→		if loadErr != nil {
   170→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   171→		}
   172→		if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   173→			transcriptOffset = sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   174→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   175→		}
   176→	}
   177→
   178→	// Parse transcript (optionally from offset for strategies that track transcript position)
   179→	// When transcriptOffset > 0, only parse NEW lines since the last checkpoint
   180→	var transcript []transcriptLine
   181→	var totalLines int
   182→	if transcriptOffset > 0 {
   183→		// Parse only NEW lines since last checkpoint
   184→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset)
   185→		if err != nil {
   186→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript from line %d: %w", transcriptOffset, err)
   187→		}
   188→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Parsed %d new transcript lines (total: %d)\n", len(transcript), totalLines)
   189→	} else {
   190→		// First prompt or no session state - parse entire transcript
   191→		// Use parseTranscriptFromLine with offset 0 to also get totalLines
   192→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   193→		if err != nil {
   194→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   195→		}
   196→	}
   197→
   198→	// Extract all prompts since last checkpoint for prompt file
   199→	allPrompts := extractUserPrompts(transcript)
   200→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   201→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   202→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   203→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   204→	}
   205→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted %d prompt(s) to: %s\n", len(allPrompts), sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName)
   206→
   207→	// Extract summary
   208→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   209→	summary := extractLastAssistantMessage(transcript)
   210→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   211→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   212→	}
   213→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted summary to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName)
   214→
   215→	// Get modified files from transcript
   216→	modifiedFiles := extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   217→
   218→	// Generate commit message from last user prompt
   219→	lastPrompt := ""
   220→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   221→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   222→	}
   223→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt)
   224→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Using commit message: %s\n", commitMessage)
   225→
   226→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   227→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   228→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   229→	if err != nil {
   230→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   231→	}
   232→
   233→	if preState != nil {
   234→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state: %d pre-existing untracked files\n", len(preState.UntrackedFiles))
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   238→	newFiles, deletedFiles, err := ComputeFileChanges(preState)
   239→	if err != nil {
   240→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   241→	}
   242→
   243→	// Filter and normalize all paths (CLI responsibility)
   244→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   245→	relNewFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(newFiles, repoRoot)
   246→	relDeletedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(deletedFiles, repoRoot)
   247→
   248→	// Check if there are any changes to commit
   249→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   250→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   251→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No files were modified during this session\n")
   252→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Skipping commit\n")
   253→		// Still transition phase even when skipping commit — the turn is ending.
   254→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   255→		// Clean up state even when skipping
   256→		if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   257→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   258→		}
   259→		return nil
   260→	}
   261→
   262→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   263→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   264→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   265→	}
   266→	if len(relNewFiles) > 0 {
   267→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "New files created (%d):\n", len(relNewFiles))
   268→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {
   269→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  + %s\n", file)
   270→		}
   271→	}
   272→	if len(relDeletedFiles) > 0 {
   273→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files deleted (%d):\n", len(relDeletedFiles))
   274→		for _, file := range relDeletedFiles {
   275→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   276→		}
   277→	}
   278→
   279→	// Create context file before saving changes
   280→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   281→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcript); err != nil {
   282→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   283→	}
   284→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Created context file: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.ContextFileName)
   285→
   286→	// Get git author from local/global config
   287→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   288→	if err != nil {
   289→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   290→	}
   291→
   292→	// Get the configured strategy
   293→	strat := GetStrategy()
   294→
   295→	// Ensure strategy setup is in place (auto-installs git hook, gitignore, etc. if needed)
   296→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   297→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   301→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   302→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   303→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   304→	}
   305→
   306→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at step/turn start)
   307→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   308→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   309→	if preState != nil {
   310→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   311→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   312→	}
   313→
   314→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific)
   315→	var tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
   316→	if transcriptPath != "" {
   317→		// Subagents are stored in a subagents/ directory next to the main transcript
   318→		subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), sessionID, "subagents")
   319→		usage, err := claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   320→		if err != nil {
   321→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to calculate token usage: %v\n", err)
   322→		} else {
   323→			tokenUsage = usage
   324→		}
   325→	}
   326→
   327→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   328→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{
   329→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   330→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   331→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   332→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   333→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   334→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   335→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   336→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptPath,
   337→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   338→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   339→		AgentType:                agentType,
   340→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   341→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   342→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   343→	}
   344→
   345→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   346→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   347→	}
   348→
   349→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   350→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   351→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   352→	// Note: Shadow strategy tracks transcript position per-step via StepTranscriptStart in
   353→	// pre-prompt state, but doesn't advance CheckpointTranscriptStart in session state because
   354→	// its checkpoints accumulate all files touched across the entire session.
   355→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   356→		// Load session state for updating transcript position
   357→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   358→		if loadErr != nil {
   359→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   360→		}
   361→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   362→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   363→		if sessionState == nil {
   364→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   365→				SessionID: sessionID,
   366→			}
   367→		}
   368→		sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = totalLines
   369→		sessionState.StepCount++
   370→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   371→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   372→		} else {
   373→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   374→				totalLines, sessionState.StepCount)
   375→		}
   376→	}
   377→
   378→	// Fire EventTurnEnd to transition session phase (all strategies).
   379→	// This moves ACTIVE → IDLE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE.
   380→	// For ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE, HandleTurnEnd dispatches ActionCondense.
   381→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   382→
   383→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   384→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   385→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   386→	}
   387→
   388→	return nil
   389→}

   391→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   392→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   393→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   394→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   395→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   396→	if err != nil {
   397→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   398→	}
   399→
   400→	// Get agent for logging context
   401→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   402→	if err != nil {
   403→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   404→	}
   405→
   406→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   407→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   408→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   409→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   410→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   411→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   412→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   413→	)
   414→
   415→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   416→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   417→	if !found {
   418→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   419→		return nil
   420→	}
   421→
   422→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   423→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   424→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   425→		return nil
   426→	}
   427→
   428→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   429→	modified, newFiles, deleted, err := DetectChangedFiles()
   430→	if err != nil {
   431→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   432→		return nil
   433→	}
   434→
   435→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   436→	if len(modified) == 0 && len(newFiles) == 0 && len(deleted) == 0 {
   437→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   438→		return nil
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	// Get git author
   442→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   443→	if err != nil {
   444→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   445→		return nil
   446→	}
   447→
   448→	// Get the active strategy
   449→	strat := GetStrategy()
   450→
   451→	// Ensure strategy setup is complete
   452→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   453→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   454→		return nil
   455→	}
   456→
   457→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   458→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   459→	if sessionID == "" {
   460→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   461→	}
   462→
   463→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   464→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   465→
   466→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   467→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   468→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   469→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   470→	if todoContent == "" {
   471→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   472→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   473→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   474→		if todoCount > 0 {
   475→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   476→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   477→		}
   478→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   479→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   480→	}
   481→
   482→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   483→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   484→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   485→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   486→	}
   487→
   488→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   489→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   490→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   491→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   492→		ModifiedFiles:       modified,
   493→		NewFiles:            newFiles,
   494→		DeletedFiles:        deleted,
   495→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   496→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   497→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   498→		IsIncremental:       true,
   499→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   500→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   501→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   502→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   503→		AgentType:           agentType,
   504→	}
   505→
   506→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   507→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   508→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   509→		return nil
   510→	}
   511→
   512→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   513→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   514→	return nil
   515→}

   517→// handleClaudeCodePreTask handles the PreToolUse[Task] hook
   518→func handleClaudeCodePreTask() error {
   519→	// Skip on default branch for strategies that don't allow it
   520→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranchForStrategy(); skip {
   521→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping on branch '%s' - create a feature branch to use Entire tracking\n", branchName)
   522→		return nil // Don't fail the hook, just skip
   523→	}
   524→
   525→	input, err := parseTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   526→	if err != nil {
   527→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PreToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   528→	}
   529→
   530→	// Get agent for logging context
   531→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   532→	if err != nil {
   533→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   534→	}
   535→
   536→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   537→	logging.Info(logCtx, "pre-task",

content.text:
Good question, let me explain the full design of this switch statement.

The `prepare-commit-msg` hook fires on **every** `git commit`. When `source` tells us how the commit was initiated, the hook decides how to present the trailer to the user:

**`source = ""` (editor flow, e.g. `git commit`):**
The user will see the message in an editor. The hook adds the trailer + a comment explaining it. The user can delete the trailer line before saving. No interactive prompt needed — the editor IS the interaction.

**`source = "message"` (e.g. `git commit -m "..."`):**
The user will NOT see an editor, so they have no chance to review/remove the trailer. The hook needs to decide: should it silently add the trailer, or ask first?

That's where `isRestoringExisting` comes in. It answers: **"Is this just re-attaching a checkpoint ID that was already condensed?"**

- `isRestoringExisting = true`: The checkpoint data already exists on `entire/sessions`. We're just putting the same ID back on a commit (e.g., `git commit --amend -m "better message"`, or splitting Claude's work across multiple commits). Safe to add silently — no new data being linked.

- `isRestoringExisting = false`: This is genuinely new session content being linked for the first time. The user might not want it linked, so → `askConfirmTTY` to ask permission.

**The gap:** The code correctly handles "user runs `git commit -m` with new content" (ask them). But it doesn't handle "**agent** runs `git commit -m` with new content" (can't ask, should just add it). Both cases have `isRestoringExisting = false`, but only the user can answer a TTY prompt.

So the fix isn't really about `isRestoringExisting` — it's about adding a third reason to skip the prompt: "a session is in ACTIVE phase, meaning the agent is the one committing."

```go
func askConfirmTTY(prompt string, context string, defaultYes bool) bool {
    tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
    if err != nil {
        return defaultYes  // true → trailer IS added
    }
```

content.thinking:
Interesting. So `askConfirmTTY` already handles the no-TTY case:

1. Line 35-39: Tries to open `/dev/tty`. If it fails, returns `defaultYes` (which is `true`).
2. Line 58-62: Tries to read from TTY. If it fails, returns `defaultYes`.

So when an agent commits, `/dev/tty` either:
- Can't be opened → returns `true` (trailer gets added) 
- CAN be opened (because the agent is running inside a terminal session that has a TTY) but the agent can't respond → it hangs waiting for input on the TTY
  
The real issue is that Claude Code runs inside a terminal like VS Code's terminal, so `/dev/tty` is actually available and opens successfully. But Claude Code controls stdin/stdout programmatically rather than through the TTY itself, which means the `ReadString('\n')` call blocks indefinitely waiting for human input that nobody's actually providing on that terminal.

The user's suggestion is to check for TTY availability instead of session phase—the logic being that agents wouldn't have a TTY while humans would. But that's not quite right either, because when Claude Code spawns a subprocess like `git commit -m "..."`, that subprocess does inherit a TTY (the controlling terminal of the process group). The problem is the agent can't actually respond to prompts on that TTY because it's driving the process programmatically.

So I need to figure out whether there's a way to distinguish between "TTY exists and a human is actually at the terminal" versus "TTY exists but an agent is controlling the process." I'm realizing the core issue: if `askConfirmTTY` were actually returning true due to TTY unavailability, the trailer would be added to the commits. But since the user says the trailers are missing, either the TTY is available and the function is blocking, or something else entirely is preventing the trailer logic from executing. Here's a summary of the changes:

**Production code** (`manual_commit_hooks.go`):
- `hasTTY()` — checks if `/dev/tty` is available. Returns false for agent subprocesses (no controlling terminal)
- Early fast path in `PrepareCommitMsg`: if `!hasTTY()` and any session is `ACTIVE`, calls `addTrailerForAgentCommit` which generates a checkpoint ID and adds the trailer directly, bypassing all content detection and TTY prompts
- `askConfirmTTY` also respects `ENTIRE_TEST_HAS_TTY` to avoid blocking in tests

**Test infrastructure** (`testenv.go`):
- `GitCommitWithShadowHooks` now passes `source="message"` and sets `ENTIRE_TEST_HAS_TTY=1` — simulates a human committing with `-m`
- `GitCommitWithShadowHooksAsAgent` — new variant that does NOT set `ENTIRE_TEST_HAS_TTY`, simulating an agent commit (no TTY)

**New test** (`mid_session_commit_test.go`):
- `TestShadowStrategy_AgentCommit_AlwaysGetsTrailer` — verifies the fast path: ACTIVE session + no TTY always gets a trailer

The key design: **TTY availability is the signal**. Human at terminal → has TTY → content detection + interactive prompt. Agent subprocess → no TTY → always add trailer for ACTIVE sessions.

    27→
    28→// hasTTY checks if /dev/tty is available for interactive prompts.
    29→// Returns false when running as an agent subprocess (no controlling terminal).
    30→// In test environments, ENTIRE_TEST_HAS_TTY=1 can be set to simulate a TTY.
    31→func hasTTY() bool {
    32→	if os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_HAS_TTY") != "" {
    33→		return true
    34→	}
    35→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
    36→	if err != nil {
    37→		return false
    38→	}
    39→	_ = tty.Close()
    40→	return true
    41→}
    42→
    43→// askConfirmTTY prompts the user for a yes/no confirmation via /dev/tty.
    44→// This works even when stdin is redirected (e.g., git commit -m).
    45→// Returns true for yes, false for no. If TTY is unavailable, returns the default.
    46→// If context is non-empty, it is displayed on a separate line before the prompt.
    47→func askConfirmTTY(prompt string, context string, defaultYes bool) bool {
    48→	// In test mode, don't try to interact with the real TTY — just use the default.
    49→	// ENTIRE_TEST_HAS_TTY simulates "a human is present" for the hasTTY() check
    50→	// but we can't actually read from the TTY in tests.
    51→	if os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_HAS_TTY") != "" {
    52→		return defaultYes
    53→	}
    54→
    55→	// Open /dev/tty for both reading and writing
    56→	// This is the controlling terminal, which works even when stdin/stderr are redirected
    57→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
    58→	if err != nil {
    59→		// Can't open TTY (e.g., running in CI), use default
    60→		return defaultYes
    61→	}
    62→	defer tty.Close()
    63→
    64→	// Show context if provided
    65→	if context != "" {
    66→		fmt.Fprintf(tty, "%s\n", context)
    67→	}
    68→
    69→	// Show prompt with default indicator
    70→	// Write to tty directly, not stderr, since git hooks may redirect stderr to /dev/null
    71→	var hint string
    72→	if defaultYes {
    73→		hint = "[Y/n]"
    74→	} else {
    75→		hint = "[y/N]"
    76→	}
    77→	fmt.Fprintf(tty, "%s %s ", prompt, hint)
    78→
    79→	// Read response
    80→	reader := bufio.NewReader(tty)
    81→	response, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
    82→	if err != nil {
    83→		return defaultYes
    84→	}
    85→
    86→	response = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(response))
    87→	switch response {
    88→	case "y", "yes":
    89→		return true
    90→	case "n", "no":
    91→		return false
    92→	default:
    93→		// Empty or invalid input - use default
    94→		return defaultYes
    95→	}
    96→}
    97→
    98→// CommitMsg is called by the git commit-msg hook after the user edits the message.
    99→// If the message contains only our trailer (no actual user content), strip it
   100→// so git will abort the commit due to empty message.
   101→//
   102→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
   103→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CommitMsg(commitMsgFile string) error {
   104→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // Path comes from git hook
   105→	if err != nil {
   106→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   107→	}
   108→
   109→	message := string(content)
   110→
   111→	// Check if our trailer is present (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   112→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); !found {
   113→		// No trailer, nothing to do
   114→		return nil
   115→	}
   116→
   117→	// Check if there's any user content (non-comment, non-trailer lines)
   118→	if !hasUserContent(message) {
   119→		// No user content - strip the trailer so git aborts
   120→		message = stripCheckpointTrailer(message)
   121→		if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   122→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   123→		}
   124→	}
   125→
   126→	return nil
   127→}
   128→
   129→// hasUserContent checks if the message has any content besides comments and our trailer.
   130→func hasUserContent(message string) bool {
   131→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   132→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   133→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   134→		// Skip empty lines
   135→		if trimmed == "" {
   136→			continue
   137→		}
   138→		// Skip comment lines
   139→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "#") {
   140→			continue
   141→		}
   142→		// Skip our trailer line
   143→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, trailerPrefix) {
   144→			continue
   145→		}
   146→		// Found user content
   147→		return true
   148→	}
   149→	return false
   150→}
   151→
   152→// stripCheckpointTrailer removes the Entire-Checkpoint trailer line from the message.
   153→func stripCheckpointTrailer(message string) string {
   154→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   155→	var result []string
   156→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   157→		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), trailerPrefix) {
   158→			result = append(result, line)
   159→		}

   161→	return strings.Join(result, "\n")

   165→// cherry-pick, or revert operation. During these operations, commits are being

   170→//   - cherry-pick: .git/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD file
   171→//   - revert: .git/REVERT_HEAD file
   172→func isGitSequenceOperation() bool {

   174→	gitDir, err := GetGitDir()
   175→	if err != nil {
   176→		return false // Can't determine, assume not in sequence operation
   177→	}
   178→
   179→	// Check for rebase state directories
   180→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-merge")); err == nil {
   181→		return true
   182→	}
   183→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-apply")); err == nil {
   184→		return true
   185→	}
   186→
   187→	// Check for cherry-pick and revert state files
   188→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "CHERRY_PICK_HEAD")); err == nil {
   189→		return true
   190→	}
   191→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "REVERT_HEAD")); err == nil {
   192→		return true

   197→
   198→// PrepareCommitMsg is called by the git prepare-commit-msg hook.
   199→// Adds an Entire-Checkpoint trailer to the commit message with a stable checkpoint ID.
   200→// Only adds a trailer if there's actually new session content to condense.
   201→// The actual condensation happens in PostCommit - if the user removes the trailer,
   202→// the commit will not be linked to the session (useful for "manual" commits).
   203→// For amended commits, preserves the existing checkpoint ID.
   204→//
   205→// The source parameter indicates how the commit was initiated:
   206→//   - "" or "template": normal editor flow - adds trailer with explanatory comment
   207→//   - "message": using -m or -F flag - prompts user interactively via /dev/tty
   208→//   - "merge", "squash": skip trailer entirely (auto-generated messages)
   209→//   - "commit": amend operation - preserves existing trailer or restores from PendingCheckpointID
   210→//
   211→
   212→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PrepareCommitMsg(commitMsgFile string, source string) error {
   213→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   214→
   215→	// Skip during rebase, cherry-pick, or revert operations
   216→	// These are replaying existing commits and should not be linked to agent sessions
   217→	if isGitSequenceOperation() {
   218→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped during git sequence operation",
   219→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   220→			slog.String("source", source),
   221→		)
   222→		return nil
   223→	}
   224→
   225→	// Skip for merge and squash sources
   226→	// These are auto-generated messages - not from Claude sessions
   227→	switch source {
   228→	case "merge", "squash":
   229→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped for source",
   230→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   231→			slog.String("source", source),
   232→		)
   233→		return nil
   234→	}
   235→
   236→	// Handle amend (source="commit") separately: preserve or restore trailer
   237→	if source == "commit" {
   238→		return s.handleAmendCommitMsg(logCtx, commitMsgFile)
   239→	}
   240→
   241→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   242→	if err != nil {
   243→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   244→	}
   245→
   246→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   247→	if err != nil {
   248→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   249→	}
   250→
   251→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   252→	// We match by worktree (not BaseCommit) because the user may have made
   253→	// intermediate commits without entering new prompts, causing HEAD to diverge
   254→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   255→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   256→		// No active sessions or error listing - silently skip (hooks must be resilient)
   257→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no active sessions",
   258→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   259→			slog.String("source", source),
   260→		)
   261→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   262→	}
   263→
   264→	// Fast path: when an agent is committing (ACTIVE session + no TTY), skip
   265→	// content detection and interactive prompts. The agent can't respond to TTY
   266→	// prompts and the content detection can miss mid-session work (no shadow
   267→	// branch yet, transcript analysis may fail). Generate a checkpoint ID and
   268→	// add the trailer directly.
   269→	if !hasTTY() {
   270→		for _, state := range sessions {
   271→			if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   272→				return s.addTrailerForAgentCommit(logCtx, commitMsgFile, state, source)
   273→			}
   274→		}
   275→	}
   276→
   277→	// Check if any session has new content to condense
   278→	sessionsWithContent := s.filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo, sessions)
   279→
   280→	// Determine which checkpoint ID to use
   281→	var checkpointID id.CheckpointID
   282→	var hasNewContent bool
   283→	var reusedSession *SessionState
   284→
   285→	if len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   286→		// New content exists - will generate new checkpoint ID below
   287→		hasNewContent = true
   288→	} else {
   289→		// No new content - check if any session has a LastCheckpointID to reuse
   290→		// This handles the case where user splits Claude's work across multiple commits
   291→		// Reuse if: LastCheckpointID exists AND (FilesTouched is empty OR files overlap)
   292→		// - FilesTouched empty: commits made before session stop, reuse checkpoint
   293→		// - FilesTouched populated: only reuse if files overlap (prevents unrelated commits from reusing)
   294→
   295→		// Get current HEAD to filter sessions
   296→		head, err := repo.Head()
   297→		if err != nil {
   298→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   299→		}
   300→		currentHeadHash := head.Hash().String()
   301→
   302→		// Filter to sessions where BaseCommit matches current HEAD
   303→		// This prevents reusing checkpoint IDs from old sessions
   304→		// Note: BaseCommit is kept current both when new content is condensed (in the
   305→		// condensation process) and when no new content is found (via PostCommit when
   306→		// reusing checkpoint IDs). If none match, we don't add a trailer rather than
   307→		// falling back to old sessions which could have stale checkpoint IDs.
   308→		var currentSessions []*SessionState
   309→		for _, session := range sessions {
   310→			if session.BaseCommit == currentHeadHash {
   311→				currentSessions = append(currentSessions, session)
   312→			}
   313→		}
   314→
   315→		if len(currentSessions) == 0 {
   316→			// No sessions match current HEAD - don't try to reuse checkpoint IDs
   317→			// from old sessions as they may be stale
   318→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no sessions match current HEAD",
   319→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   320→				slog.String("source", source),
   321→				slog.String("current_head", currentHeadHash[:7]),
   322→				slog.Int("total_sessions", len(sessions)),
   323→			)
   324→			return nil
   325→		}
   326→
   327→		stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo)
   328→		for _, session := range currentSessions {
   329→			if !session.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() &&
   330→				(len(session.FilesTouched) == 0 || hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, session.FilesTouched)) {
   331→				checkpointID = session.LastCheckpointID
   332→				reusedSession = session
   333→				break
   334→			}
   335→		}
   336→		if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   337→			// No new content and no previous checkpoint to reference (or staged files are unrelated)
   338→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no content to link",
   339→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   340→				slog.String("source", source),
   341→				slog.Int("sessions_found", len(sessions)),
   342→				slog.Int("sessions_with_content", len(sessionsWithContent)),
   343→			)
   344→			return nil
   345→		}
   346→	}
   347→
   348→	// Read current commit message
   349→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   350→	if err != nil {
   351→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   352→	}
   353→
   354→	message := string(content)
   355→
   356→	// Get or generate checkpoint ID (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   357→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   358→		// Trailer already exists (e.g., amend) - keep it
   359→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer already exists",
   360→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   361→			slog.String("source", source),
   362→			slog.String("existing_checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   363→		)
   364→		return nil
   365→	}
   366→
   367→	if hasNewContent {
   368→		// New content: check PendingCheckpointID first (set during previous condensation),
   369→		// otherwise generate a new one. This ensures idempotent IDs across hook invocations.
   370→		for _, state := range sessionsWithContent {
   371→			if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
   372→				if cpID, err := id.NewCheckpointID(state.PendingCheckpointID); err == nil {
   373→					checkpointID = cpID
   374→					break
   375→				}
   376→			}
   377→		}
   378→		if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   379→			cpID, err := id.Generate()
   380→			if err != nil {
   381→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   382→			}
   383→			checkpointID = cpID
   384→		}
   385→	}
   386→	// Otherwise checkpointID is already set to LastCheckpointID from above
   387→
   388→	// Determine agent type and last prompt from session
   389→	agentType := DefaultAgentType // default for backward compatibility
   390→	var lastPrompt string
   391→	if hasNewContent && len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   392→		session := sessionsWithContent[0]
   393→		if session.AgentType != "" {
   394→			agentType = session.AgentType
   395→		}
   396→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(repo, session)
   397→	} else if reusedSession != nil {
   398→		// Reusing checkpoint from existing session - get agent type and prompt from that session
   399→		if reusedSession.AgentType != "" {
   400→			agentType = reusedSession.AgentType
   401→		}
   402→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(repo, reusedSession)
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	// Prepare prompt for display: collapse newlines/whitespace, then truncate (rune-safe)
   406→	displayPrompt := stringutil.TruncateRunes(stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(lastPrompt), 80, "...")
   407→
   408→	// Check if we're restoring an existing checkpoint ID (already condensed)
   409→	// vs linking a genuinely new checkpoint. Restoring doesn't need user confirmation
   410→	// since the data is already committed — this handles git commit --amend -m "..."
   411→	// and non-interactive environments (e.g., Claude doing commits).
   412→	isRestoringExisting := false
   413→	if !hasNewContent && reusedSession != nil {
   414→		// Reusing LastCheckpointID from a previous condensation
   415→		isRestoringExisting = true
   416→	} else if hasNewContent {
   417→		for _, state := range sessionsWithContent {
   418→			if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
   419→				isRestoringExisting = true
   420→				break
   421→			}
   422→		}
   423→	}
   424→
   425→	// Add trailer differently based on commit source
   426→	switch {
   427→	case source == "message" && !isRestoringExisting:
   428→		// Using -m or -F with genuinely new content: ask user interactively
   429→		// whether to add trailer (comments won't be stripped by git in this mode)
   430→
   431→		// Build context string for interactive prompt
   432→		var promptContext string
   433→		if displayPrompt != "" {
   434→			promptContext = "You have an active " + string(agentType) + " session.\nLast Prompt: " + displayPrompt
   435→		}
   436→
   437→		if !askConfirmTTY("Link this commit to "+string(agentType)+" session context?", promptContext, true) {
   438→			// User declined - don't add trailer
   439→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: user declined trailer",
   440→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   441→				slog.String("source", source),
   442→			)
   443→			return nil
   444→		}
   445→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   446→	case source == "message":
   447→		// Restoring existing checkpoint ID (amend, split commit, or non-interactive)
   448→		// No confirmation needed — data is already condensed
   449→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   450→	default:
   451→		// Normal editor flow: add trailer with explanatory comment (will be stripped by git)
   452→		message = addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message, checkpointID, string(agentType), displayPrompt)
   453→	}
   454→
   455→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer added",
   456→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   457→		slog.String("source", source),
   458→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   459→		slog.Bool("has_new_content", hasNewContent),
   460→	)
   461→
   462→	// Write updated message back
   463→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   464→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   465→	}
   466→
   467→	return nil
   468→}

   470→// handleAmendCommitMsg handles the prepare-commit-msg hook for amend operations
   471→// (source="commit"). It preserves existing trailers or restores from PendingCheckpointID.
   472→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) handleAmendCommitMsg(logCtx context.Context, commitMsgFile string) error {
   473→	// Read current commit message
   474→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   475→	if err != nil {
   476→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   477→	}
   478→
   479→	message := string(content)
   480→
   481→	// If message already has a trailer, keep it unchanged
   482→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   483→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend preserves existing trailer",
   484→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   485→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   486→		)
   487→		return nil
   488→	}
   489→
   490→	// No trailer in message — check if any session has PendingCheckpointID to restore
   491→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   492→	if err != nil {
   493→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   494→	}
   495→
   496→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   497→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   498→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions - nothing to restore
   499→	}
   500→
   501→	// Find first session with PendingCheckpointID
   502→	for _, state := range sessions {
   503→		if state.PendingCheckpointID == "" {
   504→			continue
   505→		}
   506→
   507→		cpID, err := id.NewCheckpointID(state.PendingCheckpointID)
   508→		if err != nil {
   509→			continue // Invalid ID, skip
   510→		}
   511→
   512→		// Restore the trailer
   513→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
   514→		if writeErr := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); writeErr != nil {
   515→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   516→		}
   517→
   518→		logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: restored trailer on amend from PendingCheckpointID",
   519→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   520→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
   521→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   522→		)
   523→		return nil
   524→	}
   525→
   526→	// No PendingCheckpointID found - leave message unchanged
   527→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend with no pending checkpoint to restore",
   528→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   529→	)
   530→	return nil
   531→}

   533→// PostCommit is called by the git post-commit hook after a commit is created.
   534→// Uses the session state machine to determine what action to take per session:
   535→//   - ACTIVE → ACTIVE_COMMITTED: defer condensation (agent still working)
   536→//   - IDLE → condense immediately
   537→//   - ACTIVE_COMMITTED → migrate shadow branch (additional commit during same turn)
   538→//   - ENDED → condense if files touched, discard if empty
   539→//
   540→// Shadow branches are only deleted when ALL sessions sharing the branch are non-active.
   541→// During rebase/cherry-pick/revert operations, phase transitions are skipped entirely.
   542→//
   543→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
   544→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit() error {
   545→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   546→
   547→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   548→	if err != nil {
   549→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   550→	}
   551→
   552→	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
   553→	head, err := repo.Head()
   554→	if err != nil {
   555→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   556→	}
   557→
   558→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   559→	if err != nil {
   560→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   561→	}
   562→
   563→	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   564→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   565→	if !found {
   566→		// No trailer - user removed it, treat as manual commit
   567→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: no checkpoint trailer",
   568→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   569→		)
   570→		return nil
   571→	}
   572→
   573→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   574→	if err != nil {
   575→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   576→	}
   577→
   578→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   579→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   580→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   581→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: no active sessions despite trailer",
   582→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   583→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   584→		)
   585→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   586→	}
   587→
   588→	// Build transition context
   589→	isRebase := isGitSequenceOperation()
   590→	transitionCtx := session.TransitionContext{
   591→		IsRebaseInProgress: isRebase,
   592→	}
   593→
   594→	if isRebase {
   595→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: rebase/sequence in progress, skipping phase transitions",
   596→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   597→		)
   598→	}
   599→
   600→	// Track shadow branch names and whether they can be deleted
   601→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   602→	// Track sessions that are still active AFTER transitions
   603→	activeSessionsOnBranch := make(map[string]bool)
   604→
   605→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   606→
   607→	// Two-pass processing: condensation first, migration second.
   608→	// This prevents a migration from renaming a shadow branch before another
   609→	// session sharing that branch has had a chance to condense from it.
   610→	type pendingMigration struct {
   611→		state *SessionState
   612→	}
   613→	var pendingMigrations []pendingMigration
   614→
   615→	// Pass 1: Run transitions and dispatch condensation/discard actions.
   616→	// Defer migration actions to pass 2.
   617→	for _, state := range sessions {
   618→		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   619→
   620→		// Check for new content (needed for TransitionContext and condensation).
   621→		// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content exists so we
   622→		// don't silently skip data that should have been condensed.
   623→		hasNew, contentErr := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   624→		if contentErr != nil {
   625→			hasNew = true
   626→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: error checking session content, assuming new content",
   627→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   628→				slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()),
   629→			)
   630→		}
   631→		transitionCtx.HasFilesTouched = len(state.FilesTouched) > 0
   632→
   633→		// Run the state machine transition
   634→		remaining := TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventGitCommit, transitionCtx)
   635→
   636→		// Dispatch strategy-specific actions.
   637→		// Each branch handles its own BaseCommit update so there is no
   638→		// fallthrough conditional at the end. On condensation failure,
   639→		// BaseCommit is intentionally NOT updated to preserve access to
   640→		// the shadow branch (which is named after the old BaseCommit).
   641→		for _, action := range remaining {
   642→			switch action {
   643→			case session.ActionCondense:
   644→				if hasNew {
   645→					s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   646→					// condenseAndUpdateState updates BaseCommit on success.
   647→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved so the shadow branch remains accessible.
   648→				} else {
   649→					// No new content to condense — just update BaseCommit
   650→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   651→				}
   652→			case session.ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched:
   653→				// The state machine already gates this action on HasFilesTouched,
   654→				// but hasNew is an additional content-level check (transcript has
   655→				// new content beyond what was previously condensed).
   656→				if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 && hasNew {
   657→					s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   658→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved (same as ActionCondense).
   659→				} else {
   660→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   661→				}
   662→			case session.ActionDiscardIfNoFiles:
   663→				if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   664→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: skipping empty ended session (no files to condense)",
   665→						slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   666→					)
   667→				}
   668→				s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   669→			case session.ActionMigrateShadowBranch:
   670→				// Deferred to pass 2 so condensation reads the old shadow branch first.
   671→				// Migration updates BaseCommit as part of the rename.
   672→				// Store checkpointID so HandleTurnEnd can reuse it for deferred condensation.
   673→				state.PendingCheckpointID = checkpointID.String()
   674→				pendingMigrations = append(pendingMigrations, pendingMigration{state: state})
   675→			case session.ActionClearEndedAt, session.ActionUpdateLastInteraction:
   676→				// Handled by session.ApplyCommonActions above
   677→			case session.ActionWarnStaleSession:
   678→				// Not produced by EventGitCommit; listed for switch exhaustiveness
   679→			}
   680→		}
   681→
   682→		// Save the updated state
   683→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   684→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   685→		}
   686→
   687→		// Track whether any session on this shadow branch is still active
   688→		if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   689→			activeSessionsOnBranch[shadowBranchName] = true
   690→		}
   691→	}
   692→
   693→	// Pass 2: Run deferred migrations now that all condensations are complete.
   694→	for _, pm := range pendingMigrations {
   695→		if _, migErr := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, pm.state); migErr != nil {
   696→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: shadow branch migration failed",
   697→				slog.String("session_id", pm.state.SessionID),
   698→				slog.String("error", migErr.Error()),
   699→			)
   700→		}
   701→		// Save the migrated state
   702→		if err := s.saveSessionState(pm.state); err != nil {
   703→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state after migration: %v\n", err)
   704→		}
   705→	}
   706→
   707→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active
   708→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   709→		if activeSessionsOnBranch[shadowBranchName] {
   710→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: preserving shadow branch (active session exists)",
   711→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   712→			)
   713→			continue
   714→		}
   715→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   716→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to clean up %s: %v\n", shadowBranchName, err)
   717→		} else {
   718→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Cleaned up shadow branch: %s\n", shadowBranchName)
   719→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   720→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   721→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   722→			)
   723→		}
   724→	}
   725→
   726→	return nil
   727→}

   729→// condenseAndUpdateState runs condensation for a session and updates state afterward.
   730→// Returns true if condensation succeeded.
   731→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) condenseAndUpdateState(
   732→	logCtx context.Context,
   733→	repo *git.Repository,
   734→	checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   735→	state *SessionState,
   736→	head *plumbing.Reference,
   737→	shadowBranchName string,
   738→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{},
   739→) {
   740→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
   741→	if err != nil {
   742→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: condensation failed for session %s: %v\n",
   743→			state.SessionID, err)
   744→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: condensation failed",
   745→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   746→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   747→		)
   748→		return
   749→	}

   751→	// Track this shadow branch for cleanup
   752→	shadowBranchesToDelete[shadowBranchName] = struct{}{}
   753→
   754→	// Update session state for the new base commit
   755→	state.BaseCommit = head.Hash().String()
   756→	state.StepCount = 0
   757→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   758→
   759→	// Clear attribution tracking — condensation already used these values
   760→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   761→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   762→
   763→	// Save checkpoint ID so subsequent commits can reuse it
   764→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   765→	// Set PendingCheckpointID for amend trailer restoration
   766→	state.PendingCheckpointID = checkpointID.String()
   767→
   768→	shortID := state.SessionID
   769→	if len(shortID) > 8 {
   770→		shortID = shortID[:8]
   771→	}
   772→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Condensed session %s: %s (%d checkpoints)\n",
   773→		shortID, result.CheckpointID, result.CheckpointsCount)
   774→
   775→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed",
   776→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   777→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   778→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   779→		slog.Int("transcript_lines", result.TotalTranscriptLines),
   780→	)
   781→}

   794→// filterSessionsWithNewContent returns sessions that have new transcript content
   795→// beyond what was already condensed.
   796→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo *git.Repository, sessions []*SessionState) []*SessionState {
   797→	var result []*SessionState
   798→
   799→	for _, state := range sessions {
   800→		hasNew, err := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   801→		if err != nil {
   802→			// On error, include the session (fail open for hooks)
   803→			result = append(result, state)
   804→			continue
   805→		}
   806→		if hasNew {
   807→			result = append(result, state)
   808→		}
   809→	}
   810→
   811→	return result
   812→}

   814→// sessionHasNewContent checks if a session has new transcript content
   815→// beyond what was already condensed.
   816→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContent(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   817→	// Get shadow branch
   818→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   819→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   820→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   821→	if err != nil {
   822→		// No shadow branch means no Stop has happened since the last condensation.
   823→		// However, the agent may have done work (including commits) without a Stop.
   824→		// Check the live transcript to detect this scenario.
   825→		return s.sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo, state)
   826→	}
   827→
   828→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   829→	if err != nil {
   830→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   831→	}
   832→
   833→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   834→	if err != nil {
   835→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   836→	}
   837→
   838→	// Look for transcript file
   839→	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + state.SessionID
   840→	var transcriptLines int
   841→
   842→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   843→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   844→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   845→		}
   846→	} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   847→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   848→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   849→		}
   850→	}
   851→
   852→	// Has new content if there are more lines than already condensed
   853→	return transcriptLines > state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, nil
   854→}
   855→
   856→// countTranscriptLines counts lines in a transcript, matching the counting method used
   857→// in extractSessionData for consistency. This trims trailing empty lines (from final \n
   858→// in JSONL) but includes empty lines in the middle of the file.
   859→func countTranscriptLines(content string) int {
   860→	lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   861→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   862→	for len(lines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(lines[len(lines)-1]) == "" {
   863→		lines = lines[:len(lines)-1]
   864→	}
   865→	return len(lines)
   866→}

   868→// sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript checks if a session has new content
   869→// by examining the live transcript file. This is used when no shadow branch exists
   870→// (i.e., no Stop has happened yet) but the agent may have done work.
   871→//
   872→// Returns true if:
   873→//  1. The transcript has grown since the last condensation, AND
   874→//  2. The new transcript portion contains file modifications, AND
   875→//  3. At least one modified file overlaps with the currently staged files
   876→//
   877→// The overlap check ensures we don't add checkpoint trailers to commits that are
   878→// unrelated to the agent's recent changes.
   879→//
   880→// This handles the scenario where the agent commits mid-session before Stop.
   881→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   882→	// Need both transcript path and agent type to analyze
   883→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" || state.AgentType == "" {
   884→		return false, nil
   885→	}
   886→
   887→	// Get the agent for transcript analysis
   888→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
   889→	if err != nil {
   890→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Unknown agent type, fail gracefully
   891→	}
   892→
   893→	// Cast to TranscriptAnalyzer
   894→	analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer)
   895→	if !ok {
   896→		return false, nil // Agent doesn't support transcript analysis
   897→	}
   898→
   899→	// Get current transcript position
   900→	currentPos, err := analyzer.GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)
   901→	if err != nil {
   902→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error reading transcript, fail gracefully
   903→	}
   904→
   905→	// Check if transcript has grown since last condensation
   906→	if currentPos <= state.CheckpointTranscriptStart {
   907→		return false, nil // No new content
   908→	}
   909→
   910→	// Transcript has grown - check if there are file modifications in the new portion
   911→	modifiedFiles, _, err := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   912→	if err != nil {
   913→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error parsing transcript, fail gracefully
   914→	}
   915→
   916→	// No file modifications means no new content to checkpoint
   917→	if len(modifiedFiles) == 0 {
   918→		return false, nil
   919→	}
   920→
   921→	// Check if any modified files overlap with currently staged files
   922→	// This ensures we only add checkpoint trailers to commits that include
   923→	// files the agent actually modified
   924→	stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo) // TODO: does it work? Do we have staged files if this is called at post-commit hook ?
   925→	if !hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, modifiedFiles) {
   926→		return false, nil // No overlap - staged files are unrelated to agent's work
   927→	}
   928→
   929→	return true, nil
   930→}

   932→// addTrailerForAgentCommit handles the fast path when an agent is committing
   933→// (ACTIVE session + no TTY). Generates a checkpoint ID and adds the trailer
   934→// directly, bypassing content detection and interactive prompts.
   935→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) addTrailerForAgentCommit(logCtx context.Context, commitMsgFile string, state *SessionState, source string) error {
   936→	// Use PendingCheckpointID if set, otherwise generate a new one
   937→	var cpID id.CheckpointID
   938→	if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
   939→		var err error
   940→		cpID, err = id.NewCheckpointID(state.PendingCheckpointID)
   941→		if err != nil {
   942→			cpID = "" // fall through to generate
   943→		}
   944→	}
   945→	if cpID.IsEmpty() {
   946→		var err error
   947→		cpID, err = id.Generate()
   948→		if err != nil {
   949→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   950→		}
   951→	}
   952→
   953→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   954→	if err != nil {
   955→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   956→	}
   957→
   958→	message := string(content)
   959→
   960→	// Don't add if trailer already exists
   961→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   962→		return nil
   963→	}
   964→
   965→	message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
   966→
   967→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: agent commit trailer added",
   968→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   969→		slog.String("source", source),
   970→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
   971→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   972→	)
   973→
   974→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o644); err != nil { //nolint:gosec // Same permissions as git
   975→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write commit message: %w", err)
   976→	}
   977→	return nil
   978→}
